records.name: MeetPaw
records.tagline: Instant meetings from your mac menu bar
records.description: MeetPaw is a lightweight macOS menu-bar app that puts your meetings one click away. Spin up an instant Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams link the moment you need it. The link is created, copied to your clipboard, and ready to share before you've switched windows. No tabs, no digging, no friction.

records.name: Inbox Zero
records.tagline: Open-source Superhuman alternative
records.description: Inbox Zero Mail is an open-source email client for Gmail and Outlook. Fast, keyboard-first, and free to use, on web, Mac, Windows and iPhone, with all your accounts in one inbox. Add AI for $20/mo: every email is sorted, and replies are drafted in your voice before you open them. Comment privately with your team, get Slack alerts, and give the AI context from your tools.

records.name: Gravity Notes
records.tagline: One list of notes, for you and your AI agents
records.description: Gravity is a notes app built on Andrej Karpathy's append-and-review note. Everything goes into one list, newest at the top. Old notes sink, and a swipe brings one back. You pay once, and your notes stay on your devices. New since the last launch: live Markdown, checklists, full exports, and a gravity CLI on the Mac that lets Claude Code, Codex or your own scripts read and write your notes. For iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android.

records.name: Vampire Crawlers™
records.tagline: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
records.description: From the somehow triple-BAFTA‑winning creators of Vampire Survivors, Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors turns the snowballing thrill of Survivors into a hyper turn‑based, card‑driven BLOBBER with rogue-lite elements. Build busted decks, explore familiar dungeons from a new perspective, and unleash world‑ending combos. Either take your time and be tactical, or play turns as fast as you humanly can: The outcome is always accurate, we call it hyper for a reason!

records.name: Tomo for ChatGPT
records.tagline: Ask anything. Then play it, Duolingo-style.
records.description: Ask ChatGPT for a Tomo course on black holes and a game drops into the chat. Quick questions, hearts on the line. Any topic, even the chat you’re in. Pick your teacher, from The Professor to The Pirate. Add Tomo from Plugins in ChatGPT. No sign-up to start.

records.name: Popcraft
records.tagline: Generate video, images & audio from any AI agent
records.description: Paste one URL into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Claude Code and your agent can plan, cost-preview and generate video, images, music and SFX with Seedance 2.5, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Nano Banana Pro and 20+ more. OAuth sign-in, no API key. 100 free credits.

records.name: Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse
records.tagline: Amazon's personal AI memory, now on your wrist or phone
records.description: Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse are Amazon's new personal AI devices that help you remember what matters. Frontier is a wearable for your wrist or clothing, while Eclipse attaches magnetically to your phone. Both capture conversations and turn them into useful summaries, reminders, and follow-ups without retaining audio recordings. With Alexa+ integration, your personal AI memory can help you recall important details and act on them later.

records.name: SpeechFast
records.tagline: Local Whisper for Mac
records.description: Hold fn and talk. SpeechFast types clean text at your cursor, in any app. Everything runs on your Mac. The speech model is downloaded once; after that, no audio and no text ever leaves your machine. It works offline, on a plane, behind a locked-down corporate network. Dictate in Mail, Slack, Notion, your code editor, anywhere you can type Filler words and false starts cleaned up with Apple Intelligence Your own vocabulary for names and jargon History of your recent dictations, stored locally

records.name: Tower 18 for Mac
records.tagline: The most powerful Git client with a better CLI experience
records.description: Tower 18 for Mac is here! This update is all about improving the Tower experience in the terminal: the Tower Command Line Tool can now take you straight to any view in Tower (History, Blame, the Working Copy, Branches Review, and more) with a single command.

records.name: 3AM Super Intelligence
records.tagline: Production incidents: investigated, proven, fixed
records.description: Meet 3AM, the AI on-call engineer for systems you can’t rewrite. It finds the root cause, rehearses the fix, and resolves the incident with one tap in Slack, all from inside your network.

records.name: Krea 3
records.tagline: Krea's AI image model: 2K edits in under 8 seconds
records.description: Krea 3 is a fast AI image editing model built for creators and production teams. Edit images in under 8 seconds at native 2K resolution for just $0.06 per image. Change backgrounds, objects, materials, or lighting while preserving the details you want to keep. Use up to 6 reference images to maintain consistent products, characters, and styles across an entire campaign. Less waiting, fewer unwanted changes, and more room to experiment.

records.name: Openbroca
records.tagline: Lightweight AI dictation for Mac that sounds like you
records.description: Openbroca is a native Swift AI dictation app for Mac, with a ~6.5 MB download. Press a shortcut, speak naturally, and get clean text right where you're typing. It removes fillers and repetition while keeping your meaning and tone, with no prompt tweaking. Includes a personal dictionary that learns from corrections, Typeless dictionary import, and translation into 28 languages. All features are free to try.

records.name: MyLens
records.tagline: 1-1 Live Presentations at Scale with AI.
records.description: MyLens is AI for live 1-1 presentations at scale. You add your raw sources, say what matters, and invite your audience. MyLens AI gives every person a live, private presentation, answers their questions using your sources, and create new slides and layers in real time during the presentation. Then the AI tells you how each session went, so you can see who’s doing well, who’s stuck, and what to do next.

records.name: Latch
records.tagline: The app blocker you unlock by walking to your key
records.description: Latch locks distracting apps until you scan your key, and the key lives where you have to walk: an NFC sticker on the fridge, a printed QR code, or a number of steps. No account, no ads, no analytics. iPhone and Android; Pro is $9.99 once.

records.name: shim-cli
records.tagline: See what your coding agent sends. Mask what you can.
records.description: An open-source hook and local proxy for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and VS Code. In Claude Code it masks secrets and personal data in tool results before the model reads them, and shim watch shows what a session sent and cost. No account, no telemetry.

records.name: XBOX Nano Controller
records.tagline: Pocket-sized wireless gamepad with all 18 inputs
records.description: Take play to more places with the XBOX Nano Controller. Fit more play in your everyday in a smaller form factor. Connect via Bluetooth & play across devices.

records.name: PasteKit
records.tagline: Format JSON, YAML & SQL privately
records.description: Paste JSON, YAML, XML, SQL, CSV or code and get formatted, validated output instantly. 58 formats, 48 converters and JSON tools (diff, schema, repair, jq). Everything runs in your browser, enforced by a strict CSP, so nothing you paste leaves your machine.

records.name: Canduity: AI Interview Coach
records.tagline: Turn your experience into interview-ready answers.
records.description: Canduity is an AI interview coach built on 8+ years of Talent Acquisition experience. Upload your resume and a job description to get tailored interview questions, STAR answer frameworks, recruiter insights, and company research—all in one downloadable guide. Prepare with purpose for $39 per position, with no subscription.

records.name: FingerBridge
records.tagline: Fingerprint-assisted Mac unlock. Keep your keyboard.
records.description: Keep your preferred keyboard and use an external fingerprint sensor to fill supported Mac lock-screen and administrator password fields. Guided setup, fingerprint enrollment and automatic Enter. Apple Silicon, macOS 13+. Paid software ($9); requires Waveshare UART Fingerprint Sensor (F), SKU 31887, sold separately. Not Apple Touch ID; does not replace FileVault startup login, Apple Pay or passkeys.

records.name: Zalcro
records.tagline: The pre-build planning tool for vibe coders and AI builders
records.description: Zalcro is the pre-build planning tool for AI app builders. Jumping straight into prompting usually leads to a doom loop where the AI loses context and breaks your app. Zalcro solves this by mapping out your architecture before you begin. It generates a build-ready plan so your AI knows exactly what to do. Whether you use Lovable, Replit, Cursor, or Claude Code, Zalcro gives you step-by-step prompts you paste directly or connect via MCP. Build better. Plan before you prompt,

records.name: Trylume
records.tagline: Photo-based virtual try-on for fashion ecommerce
records.description: AI-powered virtual try-on solution for e-commerce stores. Shoppers upload a phrylume brings a photo-based AI try-on experience to fashion product pages. Shoppers can use a personal photo to preview a garment while browsing online. We’re building for fashion stores that want to make product discovery more visual. Try the demo, explore the shopper flow, and tell us where it feels useful—or where it needs work.

records.name: GOLEM - Next-Gen security tester for AI
records.tagline: GOLEM is a web platform for testing security of AI models
records.description: It is pre-announcement in order to spread a word around the community. GOLEM release is planned on October 31, 2026. Testing LLM security is very complex nowadays. Static payloads get patched in days, manual audits take weeks, and testing slow reasoning models usually takes 20+ hours. I built GOLEM in order to fix this by introducing Neural Attack Engine (NAE), Pyramid Mode, fancy and simple web-interface and 200+ Attack Vectors.

records.name: Atlas
records.tagline: A calm sidebar browser for Windows
records.description: Atlas is a free, calm, Arc-style browser for Windows: vertical tabs in a sidebar, Spaces, a Ctrl+T command bar, split view, Peek previews, reader mode, a built-in ad + popup blocker, tab sleep, full-page translate, per-site Boosts (your own colors, fonts, CSS/JS), sidebar media controls, a download sorter and a local stats page. Chrome extensions install straight from the Web Store. Chromium (Electron) under the hood, in-app updates. Not code-signed yet, so Windows shows a SmartScreen warning.

records.name: Mindful Brain Games
records.tagline: Puzzles, Recall, & Focus games
records.description: Mindful Brain Games puts 34 brain games and logic puzzles in one calm app, from Sudoku and Killer Sudoku to Block Puzzle and 2048. Every game plays offline, and you never need an account. Free to play, with no subscription, no paywall and no daily limit. Games start gently and grow harder as you improve, and most rounds take a minute or two, so there is always time for one more.

records.name: Freelancer Growth Systems
records.tagline: Build Systems to Grow Your Freelance Business
records.description: A practical guide to building a freelance business that can grow beyond day-to-day tasks. Learn how to create repeatable workflows, improve client management, track performance, identify bottlenecks, and choose systems that support sustainable growth at every stage—from starting out to scaling your operations.

records.name: India's Evolving Logistics Network
records.tagline: Exploring logistics innovation and India's digital commerce
records.description: Discover how logistics infrastructure supports India's growing digital economy. From transportation networks and distribution planning to the changing needs of online businesses, logistics plays a vital role in connecting sellers with customers. MagazineMetric explores Delhivery's place in this evolving industry and offers useful insights for readers interested in e-commerce, business operations, and supply chain development.

records.name: Ritmo
records.tagline: Monthly habit goals that fit real life
records.description: Set a monthly goal—12 workouts, 8 reading sessions, or 4 calls to family—and complete it when life allows. Ritmo keeps every completion when you miss a day. Choose a number or a weekly rhythm, pause and resume habits, and see clear monthly progress. Local reminders, widgets, and statistics help you follow through. No account required; habit data stays on your device. Available on iOS and Android. Free to start, with optional Pro features on iOS.

records.name: Prime AI Visibility
records.tagline: Know, fix and monitor how you show up in AI search
records.description: Prime AI Visibility is an AI Search Visibility platform that helps businesses monitor how their brand appears in AI-powered search engines and answer tools. Companies use Prime AI Visibility to track brand mentions, analyze competitor positioning, and adjust their content strategies based on real-time data from AI search. Content Studio turns real search questions and AI visibility gaps into researched, editable content, with images and structured data

records.name: StickersMaker
records.tagline: Turn your photo into animated stickers
records.description: StickersMaker turns your photo into a reusable cartoon character and creates personalized animated stickers with transparent backgrounds for WhatsApp and WeChat.

records.name: DigitalMarketBase
records.tagline: DigitalMarketBase makes everyday shopping simpler
records.description: ✨ Useful finds. Better everyday. Discover practical essentials for your home, kitchen, tech, tools, and more — all in one place. 🛍️ Explore everyday goods at DigitalMarketBase. 🔗 https://digitalmarketbase.com

records.name: Wallpyria
records.tagline: One photo across all your monitors, AI fills the gaps
records.description: Wallpyria stretches one photo across every Mac monitor or gives each screen its own wallpaper. If the photo is too narrow, on-device AI paints the missing edges, nothing is uploaded. Plus video wallpapers, dynamic wallpapers from your own photos, per-monitor schedules by time or sun position, and 44 image effects. 14-day free trial, then a one-time purchase. No subscription.

records.name: SkillArena: Focus Training
records.tagline: Two, four or eight-minute brain games, no streak pressure
records.description: SkillArena is a daily brain-training app built for short breaks. Pick Quick (about 2 minutes), Standard (about 4) or Extended (about 8). Thirteen games cover focus, memory, reasoning, numbers, careful reading and clear wording, and every question is generated fresh. The timer pauses if you leave mid-round, missing a day loses nothing, and each category gets a 1 to 100 rating with the math shown. Offline, no account, no ads. Ratings describe game performance, not IQ.

records.name: A List: Celebrity Autographs
records.tagline: Collect digital autographs and capture the signing moment
records.description: Turn celebrity encounters into keepsakes. Capture a photo, collect an autograph on your phone and optionally record the signing moment. Customise your memory, save it and share it. Photo and signature capture work offline. Available on Android.

records.name: JustCV
records.tagline: Free resume exports. 150+ templates for $7.99 once.
records.description: Build and tailor resumes in your browser without a subscription. Start with 2 free templates, save up to 5 resumes, and export PDF or PNG after sign-in. Pay $7.99 once to unlock 150+ professional templates and ongoing updates. AI job tailoring is available on both plans, with up to 5 requests per user daily and shared capacity.

records.name: Eternal Aether
records.tagline: Your characters dont just remember you, they BELONG to you.
records.description: Eternal Aether is a home for AI story characters who remember you. Every character keeps persistent memories you can view and edit, writes diaries, and grows a bond from Stranger to Eternal Bond. Pricing is printed in plain sight: free to start with 10 shards, no card, 1 shard per reply, shards never expire, no ads, no queues. Meet 88 characters, import the ones you already love, or create your own in 22 art styles. Creators keep 85–90%, and chats and character cards export instantly, any time.

records.name: Undertona
records.tagline: AI color analysis from one selfie, on iPhone
records.description: Skip the pricey draping session. Take one selfie and Undertona tells you which of the 12 color seasons you are, which colors and metals light up your face, and the lipstick, blush and eyeshadow shades made for you. Photos are analyzed, never stored.

records.name: MeusVere
records.tagline: A digital space to manage money, places, notes, and habits.
records.description: Four ways to organize the important parts of everyday life. 1. Finance Understand your cash flow without a complicated spreadsheet. Manage wallets, transactions, debts, categories, and reports in one flow. 2. Places Save meaningful places, log every visit, group locations, and look back on your journey. 3. Notes Write notes, build checklists, organize folders, and find them when needed. 4. Habits Turn intentions into rhythm. Track habits you want to build or break with schedules and daily logs.

records.name: Suikii
records.tagline: Accept digital dollars at your counter
records.description: Suikii lets cafés, market stalls, food trucks and small shops accept digital dollars at the counter. Type the amount, show a QR, and your customer approves in the Slush wallet. Paid shows up, usually 2 to 5 seconds later, and the money is already in your own Sui wallet. Suikii never holds the money and never takes a cut of a sale. It runs in the browser on the device you already have. Take USDC, USDSUI, AUSD or SUI. Shops that sell online can send a pay link instead.

records.name: aRCadeRally
records.tagline: Drive real RC cars online with live onboard video
records.description: Drive physical RC cars on real tracks through the internet, with live video from the onboard camera. aRCadeRally combines online gaming, RC vehicles and custom hardware and software. Choose a track, book a session and drive with a keyboard or compatible gamepad. Explore a crawler course, hunt markers or race on a dedicated track. We are also open to conversations with track partners, investors and strategic partners. Play: https://app.arcaderally.com/login

records.name: Reverse Engineering Anything Guide
records.tagline: Independent REA setup guides and evidence-led workflows
records.description: A free, independent field guide to REA: installation, Claude Code/Codex/Cursor setup, CLI examples, troubleshooting, and source-linked case studies. Choose setup commands in your browser and use a CSV investigation worksheet. Not the official REA project.

records.name: stillhuman
records.tagline: A little more human, every day.
records.description: little more human, and more memories, every day. Life moves fast, and so much of it slips past unnoticed. StillHuman is a calmer place: somewhere to slow down, talk to real people, and hold on to the moments that make your days yours. Reflect on your days Your journal is a quiet space that’s only yours. Write a few lines, or just talk and watch your words appear. Add a photo, pick how the day felt, and read it back whenever you like. After a month, look back at the moments that mattered.

records.name: Conduit
records.tagline: Encrypted handoffs between your Claude Code and theirs
records.description: Conduit lets your Claude Code (or Codex) send a work packet to someone else's agent: a brief plus the exact fields you need back. Encrypted and signed on your machine, tracked from sent to applied, and nothing is applied until you approve it. Zero-dependency CLI, hosted relay. $9/mo.

records.name: Honest Project tool for PMs - BerryPM
records.tagline: Intelligent project management with critical paths & drift
records.description: Ever been asked by leadership why a milestone slipped three months ago, then spent the evening digging through old sprints and tasks for the answer? BerryPM is built for that PM. It locks approved baselines, tracks drift day by day, separates the task that caused a delay from the ones that just inherited it, and lets you rewind the plan to any past date to see exactly how it looked. Live critical path, sprints, docs, GitHub and Slack included. Free for up to 4 users.

records.name: Guitar Serial Number
records.tagline: Find your guitar's age from its serial number
records.description: Free lookups for supported Fender, Squier, Gibson, Epiphone, Martin and Taylor formats. See possible years, source links and uncertain matches. Includes guitar, bass and selected amp references. No account needed; serial numbers stay in your browser.

records.name: GmailClass - Gmail Email Classifier
records.tagline: GmailClass adds categorized labels to emails in your inbox
records.description: Your inbox, labeled in your own words! GmailClass uses Jev AI to match emails to categories you describe, then adds colorful labels right inside Gmail. Spot invoices, travel updates, newsletters, or whatever matters to you at a glance! Choose your colors, fine-tune matching conditions, and let one email fit multiple categories. Your inbox stays yours: GmailClass doesn't move, archive, or delete your mail. Completely free to use, but requires a TypeSafe API key you need to set up.

records.name: PM Podcast Summaries by AllthingsPM
records.tagline: The best PM and AI podcasts, as 10-minute structured notes
records.description: Structured notes from 135 episodes of the top product management and AI podcasts, including Lenny's Podcast, How I AI and The AI Daily Brief. Each summary covers the big idea, key insights, mental models and frameworks, with the original audio player built in. New episodes added every week. Free.

records.name: CloudImageConverter
records.tagline: The ultra-fast image optimizer for dev & web designers
records.description: CloudImageConverter is a free, privacy-first image utility tool. It gives developers, web designers, and privacy-conscious users a fast way to convert, compress, and edit graphics without uploading a single byte of data to an external server. Whether you need to instantly turn heavy iPhone HEIC photos into universal JPEGs, compress website assets into and maximize your Google PageSpeed scores. CloudImageConverter handles it locally in seconds. No sign-ups, no limitations, and 100% data safety.

records.name: File Converter
records.tagline: Free Online PDF & File Converter : Simple, Fast, Secure
records.description: Meet FileCorner, your all-in-one toolkit for PDFs, documents, and images. Merge, convert, organize, protect, and customize PDFs, work with different file formats, and enhance images with built-in image tools. Explore AI-powered features for smarter document workflows, all through a clean, easy-to-use interface. No desktop software installation needed. We're building a faster, simpler way to handle everyday file tasks in one place, and we're improving it with community feedback.

records.name: CodeTrainerCard
records.tagline: A Pokémon-inspired trainer card for your GitHub profile
records.description: Turn your GitHub profile into a pixel-art trainer card inspired by Pokémon FireRed. Build yours and drop it in your README.

records.name: DeskPet
records.tagline: A native macOS app: an orange cat that lives on your Mac
records.description: DeskPet is a cute virtual pet that lives on your Mac desktop and helps you stay productive. Run Pomodoro-style focus sessions, get gentle reminders to drink water, stretch and rest your eyes, and keep track of tasks and notes. Chat with your pet by typing or voice, like “Start a 25-minute focus session” or “Add buy groceries to my tasks.” Private by default: it only reads your data if you allow it. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 14 or later.

records.name: Glimpse by Elorian
records.tagline: A visual thinking model that reasons about the real world
records.description: Glimpse is Elorian’s visual thinking model, a research preview that reasons about the physical world from what it sees. It follows objects through motion and changing viewpoints, and uses tools to write code, transform images, and watch videos. Elorian says it beats GPT-6 Astra on four multimodal benchmarks. API at $0.60 per million input tokens and $3.00 per million output. Free to try on the Elorian platform.

records.name: SSVideoSave – Free Online Video...
records.tagline: Download social videos and record X Live streams & Spaces
records.description: Want to save an X live broadcast and watch it later? A regular X video downloader only works on videos that are already posted, so it often fails on live content. Downloading saves an existing video, while recording captures a broadcast while it is available. Can you save a live stream after it ends? Sometimes. Some broadcasts stay available as replays, depending on the host’s settings. Spaces can only be replayed if the host allowed recording.

records.name: Kaku by Aimate
records.tagline: The AI voice agent that lives on your website
records.description: Kaku is a voice agent that sits on your website. She greets visitors out loud, answers questions from your own site content, books appointments on your calendar, and hands tricky ones to your team with the transcript. One line of code. Never makes things up.

records.name: WakePlan
records.tagline: Alarms for changing mornings
records.description: Never think about tomorrow's alarm again. You don't need another alarm app. You need to stop remembering to change the one you already have. WakePlan is wake-up planning for people whose mornings change week to week—especially if you alternate between two or three homes. Custody weeks, your partner's place, your own apartment: each place has its own wake time and routine. WakePlan keeps tomorrow's plan ready so you wake at the right time for where tomorrow starts. BUILT FOR THE ALTERNATOR •...

records.name: Shuffleet
records.tagline: The gym for data engineers: train on real SQL & Spark
records.description: Practice the data engineering interview questions SQL puzzles don't cover: deduplication, incremental loads, MERGE, SCD2, late data. SQL & PySpark in your browser, graded automatically. Free.

records.name: Fupori
records.tagline: A habit tracker where a small animal is counting on you
records.description: Fupori is a habit tracker for iPhone with six animal companions. Keep your habits, and your companion grows and changes form. Neglect them, and it gets worried… until it runs away. Free, no account, no ads. Made by one person. Set habit alarms so you don't forget. On iOS 26.1+, they ring one minute after an enabled habit is due if it's still unchecked.

records.name: Crypto Market Info & Alert Tool
records.tagline: Instant RSI, MA, MACD & BB for any crypto pair
records.description: Free Chrome & Edge extension + desktop app. Get instant RSI, Moving Averages, MACD, Bollinger Bands and Volume for any pair on Binance, Bybit, OKX, KuCoin & Gate.io. No account, no API key needed. Desktop version adds unlimited Watchlist and Telegram alerts.

records.name: Calculate My Finance
records.tagline: ​Instant loan, investment, and personal finance calculators
records.description: CalcMyFinance is a fast, clean, and comprehensive financial calculator designed to simplify your money decisions. Easily calculate loan payments, mortgages, investments, and personal savings in seconds with high accuracy. Built for speed, privacy, and seamless use across all devices without complex setups or logins.

records.name: Sleep Switch
records.tagline: The military sleep method, as an eyes-closed drill
records.description: Sleep Switch turns sleep techniques into guided drills you do with your eyes closed. The cognitive shuffle names 478 ordinary objects and never loops back on you. The military sleep method runs as a drill, not an article. 4-7-8 breathing is counted for you, with optional haptic cues so the phone stays face down. Nine drills, each labelled with how well studied it is. At 3am it tells you to get out of bed, and nothing is sold between 2am and 5am. No ads, no account.

records.name: BetaLobby
records.tagline: Meet Google Play’s 12-tester rule free, no paid testers
records.description: Stop chasing test-for-test swaps in forums. BetaLobby matches indie Android developers into 16-person teams (Team mode) or 1:1 matches (Auto Pair), so everyone gets 12+ testers for Google Play's 14-day closed test. - One shared Google Group: no per-app groups or opt-in link swapping - Installs and daily check-ins verified on the device, no screenshots - TRUST score keeps testers showing up for all 14 days, no ghosting Free, no paid plans.

records.name: Granite
records.tagline: Encrypted second brain your AI tools can actually use
records.description: Granite is a Markdown second brain, encrypted with a separate key for every vault and synced across phone, tablet, desktop and web. A built-in MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor search, read and update your notes, only in the vaults you allow, with answers that cite the exact note. Wikilinks, backlinks, graph, offline search, live co-editing, and SSO, SCIM and audit logs for teams. Never used to train AI. Free forever; Pro $3.99/mo, no AI surcharge.

records.name: SubShare: Subscription Tracker
records.tagline: Track renewals & split bills with friends
records.description: SubShare is the subscription manager built for people who share plans. Track every recurring charge in one dashboard. Split Netflix, Spotify, and work tools fairly with roommates, family, or friends. Get smart alerts before renewals and trials hit your card. Privacy-first: no bank login required. Works on web, iOS, and Android. Free for up to 5 subscriptions. Pro from $2.99/mo. Lifetime $39 — Product Hunt: 25% off with code PRODUCTHUNT ($29.25).

records.name: MarineDesk AI
records.tagline: The Intelligence Layer for Global Maritime Operations
records.description: Meet MarineDesk AI, an AI-powered maritime enterprise platform connecting six divisions: Procurement, Operations & Chartering, Crew Management, Technical Management, Dry Dock and Marine Superintendent. Explore our interactive showcase featuring our vision for intelligent RFQ processing, supplier collaboration, vessel intelligence and maritime workflow automation. Built for shipowners, ship managers and marine suppliers worldwide.

records.name: Advanced Fraction Calculator
records.tagline: Solve fractions step by step, in lowest terms. Free
records.description: A fraction calculator that shows its work. You can add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions or mixed numbers, including negatives. Every answer is reduced to lowest terms using exact integer math, so there are no rounding errors. You also get step-by-step solutions, equivalent fractions, and decimal and percent conversions. Extra tools let you convert decimals or percents to fractions and switch between improper and mixed forms. It also has history, copy, dark mode and keyboard shortcuts.

records.name: Bookfolio Creator
records.tagline: Write, design & publish beautiful books for free
records.description: Turn your ideas into beautiful, publish-ready books—without expensive software. Bookfolio Creator is a free online writing studio with AI-assisted writing, distraction-free editing, 32 professional design themes, and EPUB/PDF export. Import existing manuscripts, organize chapters, preview your book, and sync privately across devices. Start instantly without signing up, keep full ownership of your work, and publish anywhere. From first draft to finished book, all in one place.

records.name: Renewal Desk
records.tagline: Never miss a creator ad usage renewal
records.description: Agencies running creator ads track usage windows in messy spreadsheets, and renewals slip through. Renewal Desk fixes that. Paste the usage clause from a creator agreement and Renewal Desk saves the end date, channels (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and more), and whether it's paid, organic, or both. 30 days before a window ends, you get an email with a ready-to-send renewal draft, plus a nudge at 7 days. It's currently free during early access, and we'd love feedback from agency account managers.

records.name: SiteToDemo
records.tagline: Instant demo site generator for web tools
records.description: SiteToDemo is an all-in-one website asset extractor & demo video generator. Paste any website URL and instantly get: • Auto-generated website demo video • Website Screenshot • Logo & Favicon • Page Title + Meta Description • H1, Canonical tag and Open Graph metadata • Structured JSON-LD copy • One-click screenshot download Perfect for SaaS founders, marketers, SEO specialists and developers to audit sites, collect branding assets and create demo videos quickly.

records.name: Amy
records.tagline: AI tutor with live voice, interactive visuals & quizzes
records.description: Meet Amy, an AI-powered tutor built to make learning more interactive and personalized. Go beyond simple text explanations with live voice tutoring, interactive whiteboards, visual diagrams, quizzes, and AI-generated learning materials, including presentations, images, and videos. records.description: Automated B2B bookkeeping portal cross-referencing bank transactions with invoices, flagging unpaid clients and amount discrepancies with QuickBooks and Xero sync.

records.name: Snipora
records.tagline: A private snippet vault for everything you reuse.
records.description: Snipora is a privacy-first, local-first vault for reusable text, images and files. Save what matters, organize it with folders and vaults, then find it when you need it on iPhone, Android and Mac.

records.name: Drone Forecast — Mobile Assist
records.tagline: Hourly drone weather, optional Premium wind at four heights
records.description: Android weather app for drone pilots: hourly forecasts, limited free access, and optional Premium wind at 10, 80, 120 and 180 m plus map layers. The website adds a free wind-speed converter and editable, printable preflight checklist.

records.name: Ginga
records.tagline: A desktop workspace for AI coding and agent teams
records.description: Ginga brings AI-assisted development into one desktop workspace. Connect your local Oh My Pi setup, organize projects and sessions, and use Builder to coordinate role-based agents through planning, implementation, review, and evidence-backed checkpoints. Spaces group work across client projects so you can keep each codebase and conversation easy to find.

records.name: RightPickr
records.tagline: A dating app for your neighbors' free stuff
records.description: Swipe through what your neighbors are giving away, only within walking distance. Free, $1 or $5. Swipe right, pick a time the owner already set, walk over, show a code. No search bar, no "is this still available?", no haggling.

records.name: Stash: Voice Expense Tracker
records.tagline: Track spending by talking, not typing.
records.description: Stash is a voice expense tracker and budget planner for people who hate typing. Say what you spent or scan the receipt, and your expense is logged in seconds. Most expense trackers fail because logging takes too long. Stash is a money manager without the typing: speak it, scan it, approve it. Voice expense tracker: say what you spent and Stash creates a clear entry Receipt scanner: photograph a receipt and extract the details Cash spending tracker: log cash purchases without filling in forms...

records.name: Lumencam | Pocket Camera
records.tagline: Retro & Film Filters
records.description: Lumencam is a pocket camera for iPhone with film and custom looks you see live before you shoot. Import your own LUTs (.cube or HALD), build presets in the app, save full camera setups as profiles, and shoot RAW for free. No editing afterwards.

records.name: Subqora
records.tagline: Track every subscription, never pay for a forgotten one
records.description: Subqora keeps all your subscriptions in one place so you stop paying for things you forgot about. Add Netflix, Spotify, iCloud, ChatGPT and 140+ popular services with real logos in a tap, or add your own. Get renewal reminders before you're charged, see monthly and yearly spending at a glance, and spot what to cancel. Free to use, with Subqora Pro for an ad-free, premium experience. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: Macro Rush
records.tagline: Your calories, as a character.
records.description: Your calories, as a character. Log a meal and watch your meter fill: a cat that curls into a loaf, a koi pond that rises, a 3D plush dino whose zip closes as you reach your target. Dark, Light and Live glass themes, and home-screen widgets.

records.name: Wallistic- 4K Dark & Aesthetic wallpaper
records.tagline: Curated 4K high quality Dark/Amoled and Aesthetic wallpapers
records.description: Wallistic is a modern Android Wallpaper app, designed especially for people who want high quality clean images to personalize their phones Discover High quality 4K Dark, Amoled as well as soft Aesthetic wallpapers in normal and celebrative themes. Scroll through custom collection including pastel arts, line arts as well as anime arts. It contains different sections (Dark and Aesthetic) for different moods. Built with smooth native UI in KMP for effortless scrolling and swiping through carousels.

records.name: Reviewyoutube.com
records.tagline: Don't just watch. Fact-check any YouTube video instantly.
records.description: Paste any YouTube link to get an instant 1-10 score and fact-checked verdict. Whether a video is complete noise or an excellent 8/10 guide hiding two false claims, ReviewYouTube cross-examines the transcript so you know the truth. (247 characters)

records.name: WalkThen
records.tagline: Turn your steps into screen time for distracting apps
records.description: WalkThen locks the apps you open on autopilot and unlocks them with steps. Pick an app, walk, and every 500 verified iPhone steps earns 10 minutes of access. When the session ends, the app locks again. No account needed. Credit only comes from verified iPhone steps (Apple Health is display-only), built on Apple's Screen Time API. Emergency unlock is always available in Settings. Free: 1 app, 5/10-min sessions. Pro: multiple apps, categories & websites, custom rules, access hours.

records.name: SideKit
records.tagline: Capture, translate and act on your Android screen
records.description: SideKit brings screen tools and everyday actions alongside your Android apps. Capture and pin content, recognize text with OCR, translate it, and use detected QR codes, addresses, phone numbers and dates. Keep text or voice notes, insert saved phrases, and open app, web or map shortcuts. Gestures, home widgets, reminders, and library and settings backup help keep these tools close at hand. Android only.

records.name: Dama
records.tagline: Study your collections with handwriting, voice and photos
records.description: Dama turns your own collections and imported lists into study material on Android and iPhone, from languages to chemistry symbols. Answer by handwriting or voice, hear pronunciation, turn recognized words from photos into cards, and follow your learning calendar and daily records. Android also offers resizable home widgets and pop-ups over other apps. The web version is planned after the sync update; widgets and pop-ups are Android only.

records.name: 日本ニュース手帖
records.tagline: Japanese news, saved stories and your own reading notebook
records.description: A personal notebook for Japanese news. Choose news sources, search headlines and publishers, browse topics, save articles and collect your own notes around related stories. Saved headlines and notes remain available offline; full articles open on publisher sites and may require a subscription or login. Free for personal, non-commercial use, with no account required. Your saved articles, notebooks and reading history stay on your device. Available on Japan’s App Store.

records.name: Voice Diary - AI Voice Journal
records.tagline: Why type when you can speak
records.description: AudioDiary turns everyday conversations with yourself into meaningful, organized knowledge. Instead of typing journal entries, users simply speak freely, and AI transforms their thoughts into structured journal entries while building a personal knowledge graph that connects their experiences, ideas, goals, and memories over time. We make self-reflection effortless, natural, and more valuable by helping people not just record their lives, but understand them.

records.name: Unva
records.tagline: Quit vaping your way: stop now or cut down first
records.description: Unva helps you work toward quitting vaping in two ways: track vape-free time or count puffs and follow a gradual reduction plan. Log triggers, see your progress, and use craving tools when you need a pause. Core tracking is free.

records.name: Billr: AI Invoice Maker
records.tagline: Create invoices & estimates in seconds using voice AI.
records.description: Billr is the ultimate AI invoice and estimate maker for freelancers, contractors, and gig workers. Ditch manual timesheets and paper billing. Generate professional PDFs, embed one-tap "Pay Me" links, track billable hours, and instantly invoice your clients using voice dictation. Spend less time on bookkeeping and more time getting paid.

records.name: MySiteGPT Assistant
records.tagline: Create an AI assistant from your website content
records.description: Turn your website content into an AI assistant that answers your visitor questions using your information. Help visitors find information find answers faster and support your business with automated conversations.

records.name: PrecisDesk
records.tagline: Screenshots, screen recording and window snapping for Mac
records.description: PrecisDesk replaces three Mac utilities: screen capture with annotation, blur and on-device OCR; screen recording with webcam picture-in-picture, editable on-device captions and MP4/GIF export; and keyboard window snapping that can restore your layout after you unplug a monitor. Everything runs on your Mac. No account. $9.99 once, no subscription.

records.name: Filary
records.tagline: Scan and organize your 3D filament on iPhone and iPad
records.description: Filary keeps your 3D-printing filament inventory on iPhone and iPad. Scan labels, track remaining weight and get low-stock alerts. Works across brands, with optional iCloud sync and CSV/JSON export. Free for 10 spools and 10 saved scans; a one-time Pro upgrade unlocks unlimited use. The video previews v1.2.2 (awaiting Apple review): 608 recognized codes for 579 filament variants from 12 brands, plus improved color selection.

records.name: Flowly : Period Tracker
records.tagline: Flowly is a private, friendly menstrual cycle tracker
records.description: Flowly is a private, friendly menstrual cycle tracker that lives entirely on your phone. No account, no server, no sharing — your cycle data never leaves your device. Flowly is made for teens and women who want a calm, kind, and genuinely private way to understand their cycle. Everything you need, nothing you don't. Please note: Flowly shares general information only. It is not a medical service, diagnosis, or birth control method. Predictions are estimates based on what you log. Talk to a...

records.name: Keelbook
records.tagline: Offline logbook for UK narrowboat hours & papers
records.description: Keelbook is a private maintenance logbook for UK narrowboat owners — not a canal map, not a 14-day mooring or CRT cruise-evidence app. Log engine hours with gloves-friendly +1 / +0.5 / custom taps. Record pump-outs and water fills. Keep one expiry each for BSS, CRT licence, and insurance, with optional local reminders 30 / 7 / 1 days before due. Everything stays on your iPhone: no account, no cloud, no ads. Airplane mode works. £7.99 once on the App Store.

records.name: Blindly
records.tagline: Meet the mood, not the face
records.description: Blindly is a dating app where faces stay hidden until you both say yes. You pick a daily mood and intention and send a 30-second voice or video intro instead of photos. Everyone uses an alias and distance is approximate. Every member is Aadhaar-verified. You can hide anyone in your phone contacts with one tap. People connect on personality first, without being seen by strangers or by people they know. Now going live in Bangalore on iOS and Android.

records.name: TeleV
records.tagline: Telegram on your TV, finally
records.description: Telegram has no official Android TV app. TeleV fills the gap: sign in by scanning a QR code with your phone, then watch videos and live streams from your Telegram channels, groups and chats on the TV, navigating everything with the remote. Continue watching, playback speed and favorite channels included. Free, no ads, no tracking, built on Telegram's official TDLib. Updates and bug reports: t.me/telev

records.name: I Am Mate
records.tagline: Text friendly AI characters who remember you
records.description: I Am Mate lets you text with 20 friendly AI characters, each with their own job, hobbies and personality: Jennifer the bookworm, Jack the gym and gaming buddy, Olivia the chef, Maya who helps you practise English, and more. Replies feel like texting a friend, and with Plus they remember your goals and life. Safe by design: every character says it's an AI, no romance or adult content, and real helplines are one tap away. Free: 5 messages a day. Plus: $7/month.

records.name: ContentHub: Save Links
records.tagline: Save the content you love. Find it when you need it.
records.description: Tired of losing YouTube videos, articles, and posts across apps? ContentHub is a dead-simple link saver for Android. Share any URL into your private library, then reopen it when you’re ready; with continue-watching and read-later built in. Ideal if you bookmark too much, finish too little, and want one calm place for everything worth revisiting. ContentHub: save links. Continue later. Save Links, Bookmarks, Watch Later, Read Later, Share Content, Instagram Saver, Linkedin Saver, Raindrop...

records.name: Melodic Recorder
records.tagline: Record, organize, edit, and export audio in one place
records.description: Keep a quick recording useful after the moment passes. Capture song ideas, rehearsals, interviews or demos; review the waveform; trim and edit audio; and add effects without leaving the browser. Tag recordings so they stay easy to find, sync them to the cloud, and export the result for your next step. Melodic Recorder is built for musicians and creators who want capture and organization together. Free features with optional paid upgrades. Also available on Android.

records.name: Situ.art
records.tagline: See your artwork hanging in 600+ real rooms at once
records.description: Upload a photo of a painting, print or photograph, add its size, and see it hanging in 600+ rooms at once. Pick the rooms that suit it, add a frame, or ask AI to add people, furniture or a new angle. The artwork never changes. Free, no watermark.

records.name: Nimblewit App
records.tagline: All your investment accounts. One quick-witted view.
records.description: Nimblewit is a portfolio tracker for investors with Canadian and US holdings. Import your history from statements, screenshots or a CSV, then see your return next to the S&P 500 or the TSX, dividends received and expected, automatic DRIP, cash balances and allocation across accounts. Prices are updated at market close. Free to start: every new account gets Builder free for 30 days, no card needed.

records.name: Little Gasp
records.tagline: Tiny surprise websites they play, not just read
records.description: Make a personalised surprise website in 5 minutes. Add photos, little notes and a letter, then send one private link. They don't just read it, they play it: light birthday candles, crack a wax seal, mend a broken heart piece by piece or ride a scooter down memory lane. Watch the full preview free before paying. For birthdays, apologies, love letters, anniversaries and Indian festivals. No app needed.

records.name: PrintxPDF
records.tagline: Clean web printing and privacy-first PDF tools
records.description: PrintxPDF brings together a Chrome extension for clean web printing and 44 PDF and file tools. Most PDF actions run in your browser. Eight conversion and security workflows upload files to our Worker. The PDF editor adds text, shapes, signatures, and comments as overlays instead of rewriting original PDF text. Free tools need no account.

records.name: JetKreate
records.tagline: The creator platform for everyone with an idea
records.description: Your whole creative process in one place. JetKreate helps you find the idea, write it, make it and share it: images, video, audio and scripts, plus a creator profile to show your work. Start with a sentence, a photo or a trend.

records.name: Viewlify
records.tagline: See exactly why any TikTok blows up, in seconds
records.description: Paste any TikTok @handle and see which videos really broke out. Viewlify scores every video by its multiple: how many times it beat the creator's own usual views. Then it shows the hooks, formats and posting patterns behind each breakout, plus an AI plan for what to post next. Also free: a daily trending page (videos, hashtags, sounds by niche) and 20+ creator tools with no signup.

records.name: Chetian Holdings LLC
records.tagline: Casino Floor Live! Cross-play Multiplayer Casino Experience.
records.description: Free on the App Store. A social multiplayer cross-play casino party game for iPhone, iPad and Apple Vision Pro: up to 10 friends on one live floor, the house's own shows on TV, and a cast of 67 to collect. Virtual chips only.

records.name: SnipeChain
records.tagline: crypto
records.description: Snipechain provides enterprise-grade Web3 infrastructure, delivering turnkey automated token launchpads and high-performance EVM/Solana toolkits. Unlike fragmented custom builds, our production-ready white-label architecture eliminates months of engineering overhead, empowering developers and fintech firms to deploy scalable blockchain infrastructure instantly.

records.name: Cash Cells
records.tagline: A fun bubble income and net worht management tool / game
records.description: CashCells combines the satisfying progression of incremental games like Cookie Clicker with personal finance. Instead of simply watching numbers on a screen, you can visualize your net worth growing through expanding bubbles. The goal is to make tracking your finances more engaging, satisfying, and rewarding. Whether you're saving money, building investments, or working toward financial independence, CashCells aims to make your financial progress more tangible and enjoyable.

records.name: SellAI
records.tagline: Generate ad copy and product descriptions with AI
records.description: SellAI is a smart AI assistant designed for marketers, business owners, realtors, and e-commerce sellers. It automatically generates high-converting sales copy, ad text for Facebook/Instagram/Google, and compelling product descriptions in seconds with zero complex prompting required.

records.name: EasyLottie
records.tagline: Free Lottie tools to preview, edit and convert
records.description: Preview, recolor, replace images, compress and convert Lottie animations in your browser. Core tools are free, require no signup, and process files locally. Convert video to Lottie or GIF, and remove solid-color video backgrounds for transparent exports. Built for designers and developers who need quick edits without opening After Effects.

records.name: Launch Nest LN
records.tagline: Launch your product. Get discovered — fairly.
records.description: Launch Nest LN is the fair launch platform for SaaS, AI tools & indie products. Rankings run on verified upvotes, views, saves & reviews — money can never buy the top spot. NEW in this 2.0 launch: LN Finder, an AI assistant that hears your problem and finds the right product from our catalog. Also: Ask-AI buttons on every product, 28 categories, verification badges, founder stories & transparent pricing (launch free, Pro $5, Premium $10). 483+ products launched, 2M+ page views.

records.name: FollowUp Mini Browser CRM
records.tagline: Attach sticky customer notes & reminders to any webpage
records.description: Turn any webpage, LinkedIn profile, or customer portal into a mini CRM. Pin sticky notes, lead statuses, and follow-up deadlines that persist across browsing sessions. Key Highlights: - Pin persistent customer notes to exact URLs - Color-coded pipeline statuses (Lead, Follow-up, Closed, Won) - Global search dashboard to find all past notes instantly - Stores data locally in browser with 1-click JSON/CSV backup

records.name: AI Lecture Recorder
records.tagline: Lectures, bookmarks, transcibe
records.description: Most recorders give you hours of audio and no way back to what mattered. AI Lecture Recorder lets you tap a live bookmark the moment something important is said, then jump straight to it later. Recordings stay on your iPhone (local-first, no data collected), with background recording, pause/resume, trimming, and speed playback. AI transcription is optional, so you only use it when you need searchable text. Export audio along with notes, bookmarks, and transcripts.

records.name: J.A.R.V.I.S
records.tagline: A personal AI assistant for your daily workflows
records.description: Horological obsidian engineering assistant. Search, query, and synthesize system architectureJarvis is an interactive, lightweight personal AI assistant designed to streamline everyday web queries, automations, and quick task management. Built from scratch and live in version 0.0.0, it delivers fast, focused responses directly in your browser.s entirely by voice.

records.name: Itch Finder
records.tagline: Find problems worth solving, backed by real evidence
records.description: Itch Finder scans online communities like Reddit and Hacker News for real complaints, then scores each problem by demand, trend, willingness to pay and competition. Every score links back to the evidence: dates, sources and the actual quotes. See which problems are unsolved, which are crowded, and where people say they'd pay. Bookmark what stands out and get new finds in a daily digest. Free during early access.

records.name: Lobby
records.tagline: Turn two photos into a playful AI duo video
records.description: Lobby turns two individual photos into a 15-second AI duo video. Pick from six scenes for people or pets, choose portrait, landscape or square, and download an MP4 with generated audio. Try the free photo layout in your browser, then pay for one video or a one-time pack. No subscription.

records.name: Alcove
records.tagline: A calm to-do list and notebook in your Mac menu bar
records.description: Alcove keeps your whole day one click away in the Mac menu bar, with iPhone and iPad apps. Press Option-Space in any app and type a task in plain words. Plan on a calendar with an hour grid or on kanban boards, keep notes whose tables total themselves, and tick tasks off from widgets. Reminders can ring like an alarm on iOS 26. Everything syncs through your own iCloud: no account, no ads, no tracking. Free for 14 days, then $29.99 once for Mac, iPhone and iPad.

records.name: Lematev  | Control layer for AI Agent
records.tagline: Control AI agent costs and prevent unnecessary spending
records.description: Lematev helps companies control AI agent costs in real time. Unlike tools that only monitor spending, Lematev works directly between agents and AI providers to route requests to the right models, prevent runaway loops, enforce budgets, and track costs by agent and task. By focusing on the cost of completing tasks successfully not just the price of each call Lematev helps teams reduce waste and scale AI with confidence.

records.name: Allyson Run
records.tagline: A running coach for women that adapts when your week changes
records.description: Allyson is an AI running coach on iPhone, made for women who run. Tell her your race and the days you can train, and she writes your plan, from a first 5K to a marathon. When your week changes, message her and she moves the plan around it. If you run with a Garmin, Coros, Polar or Suunto, your paces come from your own runs. Your plan is free, and your coach is free for your first two weeks.

records.name: Quitar Fondo
records.tagline: Eliminar Fondo de Imagen 100% Automático y Gratis
records.description: Eliminar Fondo de Imagen 100% Automático y Gratis Quita el fondo de fotos de personas, productos para e-commerce, autos y logotipos en segundos. Recorte transparente de alta precisión sin marcas de agua.

records.name: Propovo
records.tagline: AI proposals, client rooms and follow-up in one place
records.description: Turn client notes and meeting transcripts into editable proposals, SOWs, contracts and quotes. Share branded client rooms, collect e-signatures and follow engagement alongside contacts and deals. Copilot helps teams draft, review and move work forward. Premium is $29 per seat/month or $288 per seat/year. Clients are free. Try it for 14 days with 250 AI credits and no card.

records.name: CineTrotter
records.tagline: See where any movie was filmed, or request it to be mapped
records.description: Search a movie and see where every scene was really shot: 10,000+ locations from 750+ films. Not there yet? Request it in the app: CineTrotter tracks down its filming locations and adds them to the map for everyone. Free website in 14 languages, iOS & Android.

records.name: TrenchHQ
records.tagline: Your crypto desktop companion for Windows
records.description: TrenchHQ brings crypto prices, wallet activity, X feeds, websites and apps into customizable Windows overlays and screen-edge panels. Keep what matters visible across your monitors without constantly switching tabs. Free and open source.

records.name: Applylane
records.tagline: Job hunting is hard. Keeping track shouldn't be.
records.description: Applylane keeps your whole job search on one board without the busywork. Save a job from LinkedIn, Indeed, Workday or 20+ other job sites in one click, forward your job emails and it works out what changed, and see which applications actually get replies. It's free.

records.name: Titan Audit: Current Logger 0.5S class
records.tagline: A faster way for Energy Auditors to start an audit
records.description: Rapid-deployment energy logger with split-core CTs. Installs in under five minutes, no shutdown. Class 0.5S metrology designed to IEC 62053-22. Functions as current logger, AC current logger, voltage and current data logger. PDF audit reports from the Titan App that support BEE PAT workflows.

records.name: Image Save
records.tagline: Save web images as JPG, PNG or PDF - free, local, no limits
records.description: Right-click to save Image Save adds Save original and Save as JPG / PNG / WebP / GIF / PDF to the right-click menu of images. Conversion runs on your device: nothing is uploaded, no account, no ads, no usage limits. Free forever. an image unchanged or as JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF or PDF. Convert WebP to JPG locally, free, no sign-up.

records.name: Orinami
records.tagline: A mind map tool where each node is a full document
records.description: Most mind map tools give each node a line of text. Once an idea grows, you copy it into a separate document, and the map and the writing drift apart. Orinami puts a full document inside every node. Lay ideas out on the map, open any node to write it properly, or switch to an outline of the same tree. The map, the outline and the documents are always one thing, so nothing gets out of sync.

records.name: LoopCall: AI Scam Blocker
records.tagline: Let AI answer scam calls, block scams, & waste their time
records.description: LoopCall blocks known scam numbers instantly, and its AI engages everything else — wasting robocallers' time and making their operation economically unviable. Free to start, no credit card required.

records.name: Tesla Roadster AI Video Generator
records.tagline: Turn one car photo into fictional flying-car videos
records.description: Create fictional Tesla Roadster and flying-car videos from one reference photo. Pick a scene prompt, customize the action, and choose landscape or vertical output, 5–15 seconds, and 480p or 768p resolution. Download your result as an MP4. Paid credits are required; no free generation. An independent creative tool, not affiliated with Tesla.

records.name: Milky Way Playground
records.tagline: agentic, RAG, AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Fullstack Engineer
records.description: One workspace for AI agents: RAG answers from your documents, stock analysis, casual chat and multi-agent research.

records.name: gift card
records.tagline: 🎁 Unlock Rewards, Grab Your Gift Card!
records.description: 🎁 Unlock Rewards, Grab Your Gift Card! 🎉 Discover Your Rewards[https://ln.run/d73rK]

records.name: Wacchi
records.tagline: Your Mac's charger wattage, live in the menu bar
records.description: Wacchi keeps two numbers in the menu bar: the watts your Mac is drawing from its charger right now, and below it the most that charger can give. It doesn't drop to 0W when you stop charging at 80%, because it reads what comes in to the whole Mac rather than into the battery. Open the menu to see the charger's name next to what it is actually giving, so a 96W charger stuck at 60W points you at the cable or the port. Records nothing. A free, open-source WattsConnected alternative.

records.name: Bulin 47 AI
records.tagline: Turn one photo into the viral 19-second Bulin 47 freestyle
records.description: Put yourself in the viral 19-second Bulin 47 freestyle from one photo. Choose the original street crowd or a World Cup crowd, then download a vertical MP4 in 480p or 720p with original sound or a silent copy. No prompts, editing timeline or watermark. One-time credit packs start at $9.99; failed renders are refunded. An independent fan-made tool, not affiliated with Bulin 47, Kevin Wai or their labels.

records.name: Celeris Realtime
records.tagline: Realtime Infrastructure for Builders
records.description: Celeris delivers live messages between browsers, mobile applications, backends, and services, for chat, order status, and live dashboards.

records.name: Auctionly
records.tagline: Advertisers, publishers, campaigns, RTB bidding manager
records.description: Auctionly is a complete campaign manager: the bidder, publisher portal and billing for buying and selling push, pop, domain redirect and deeplink traffic. Buy from ad exchanges over OpenRTB 2.5 with a bid out in under 100 ms, or from publishers you onboard yourself, who send visitors through a tracked link with their own sub ID and click ID. Every click, conversion and dollar stays on a server you control.

records.name: Memor More: Enhanced flashcards
records.tagline: A new way to create educational material
records.description: Today, I’m presenting a new way to create cards, or rather, full-fledged learning materials, based on schemes/diagrams and any images you need to memorize. Memor-More uses spaced repetition — cards appear just before you forget them. Adaptive reviews, rich cards (images & audio), AI decks, shared groups & ready-made content. Data stays on device & iCloud. No account needed.

records.name: miniz.fun
records.tagline: A little corner of the internet to play, create, and explore
records.description: MiniZFun is a growing collection of 40+ playful games and interactive experiences, all built from scratch. Carve a pumpkin, play a piano that makes a dancer move with every note, or explore AI through hands-on experiments. Watch a real trained neural network recognize your drawings, then see how an adversarial attack can fool it live. From creative toys to educational experiments, there's always something new to discover. No downloads or signups required, just open your browser and have fun!

records.name: CreateBrand
records.tagline: Create a cohesive brand identity in seconds.
records.description: Free brand identity generator: create color palettes and font pairings, preview them on real UI components, and export a Markdown brand guide. No signup.

records.name: LaunchHome
records.tagline: Feels like Apple never removed Launchpad
records.description: Launchpad has been gone since macOS 26. LaunchHome has everything it had: full-screen app grid, folders, drag to arrange, instant search, and the same look and feel. Plus what Launchpad never had: widgets (calculator, clock, clipboard history), files, links and Shortcuts right in the grid, and custom icons with clean uninstall. And it stays light: about 100 MB of memory, a 4 MB download. One license covers up to 3 Macs. Made by an indie dev who missed Launchpad too.

records.name: MIRA Stories
records.tagline: The AI online photo book: photos in, story out
records.description: MIRA turns a folder of trip, wedding or family photos into a magazine-style story in about a minute. It picks the best shots, builds chapters and writes the captions. Share one link that opens on any phone, or keep it as a print-ready PDF.

records.name: beaniebrand
records.tagline: Pixar-like brand logos and mascots people remember
records.description: beaniebrand turns your product description into a memorable, pixar-like, cute logo and matching mascot. Ask for changes in plain English then download a complete kit with logos in multiple sizes and colors, an animated React mascot, and a skill file to help your coding agent add it into your product.

records.name: Codezy
records.tagline: Turn ideas into web apps. Build, host & manage with AI.
records.description: Build websites and functional web applications with AI. Create dashboards, CRM systems, HR tools, and data-driven apps. Codezy helps you generate, update, preview, and manage your projects in one workspace.

records.name: PelloMail
records.tagline: Take control of your email campaigns
records.description: PelloMail Pro is a Windows desktop email marketing platform for running campaigns, managing SMTP accounts, personalizing emails with AI, and checking deliverability before sending. It combines multi-campaign automation, email verification, analytics, PDF reports, live sending logs, and separate workspaces in one application, giving marketers and businesses more control over their email operations.

records.name: Your creative Ads
records.tagline: Turn product photos into video ads in minutes
records.description: Upload up to 4 product photos, pick a style and a format, and AdTake turns them into a short AI video ad for TikTok, Reels, Shorts or your store. No prompts, no timeline, no editing. Your MP4 is ready in minutes. Plans from €11.99/month.

records.name: Pluton
records.tagline: Generate complete architecture designs from simple prompts.
records.description: We're building an AI tool which helps engineers and architects generate complete 3-dimensional building designs from simple text prompts saving them weeks of manual hectic design. Our model is one of the fastest on the market and has a response time of less than 1 second on average. Our software is generally flexible and offers the ability to interact with every single generated structural member (walls, windows, doors) in a 3D environment. That said, our product is still in beta.

records.name: swarmcore electronics
records.tagline: AI Agents for Autonomous RF & Electronics Engineering
records.description: SwarmCore is launching a multi-agent AI platform designed to automate the work of RF and electronics development. Unlike general-purpose AI assistants and traditional engineering software, SwarmCore coordinates specialized AI agents to research scientific publications, analyze technical requirements, identify components, compare design solutions, and support engineering calculations and verification.

records.name: Football Edge Lab
records.tagline: Football forecasts & what-if simulations for six leagues
records.description: Free football predictions and season simulations for the Premier League, Championship, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A and Ligue 1. Explore win, draw and goal probabilities, predicted final tables, title and relegation-zone chances. Test what-if results and follow each club's upcoming fixtures with expected points. Separate league models, timestamped pre-match forecasts, public performance records and original data research help you check the evidence. Probabilities, not guarantees.

records.name: Zusio
records.tagline: Turn 'we should hang out' into an actual plan
records.description: We see a huge market for real-life events, yet making plans with friends still gets stuck in group chats. Zusio turns 'we should hang out' into an actual meetup. Set a time, place and group size, invite friends or make it discoverable, and let others join or request a spot. Event chats keep everyone in sync with messages, photos, videos, voice notes and location sharing. See all your upcoming plans in one place. Built for spontaneous meetups on iPhone.

records.name: GRCline
records.tagline: A premium Framer template for cybersecurity consultants
records.description: GRCline is a premium Framer website template designed for virtual CISOs, cybersecurity consultants, and GRC advisory firms. Built to communicate credibility and expertise, it features responsive layouts, CMS-powered compliance framework pages covering SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA, GDPR, and CIS Controls, plus case studies, insights, and lead capture forms. A ready-made website foundation for security professionals who want to present their services with clarity and confidence.

records.name: Nodetto
records.tagline: A drawing tool for humans and AI
records.description: Draw interfaces, databases and systems on a local macOS canvas, or let AI edit the same Git-friendly JSONL files. A bundled Rust CLI and MCP server support drawing, inspection and SVG/PNG/PDF export. Free, open source, with no Node.js or Bun required.

records.name: Sellmitra
records.tagline: Every seller’s ecommerce mitra
records.description: Sellmitra lets Indian sellers launch their own online store with no coding and zero sales commission. Built for Instagram, WhatsApp, marketplace and offline sellers who want a direct channel they control. What stands out: - Partial advance on COD orders to help reduce RTO - Share a cart for family or team purchases - Resellers add their own margin when sharing - Loyalty points, coupons, WhatsApp notifications - Installable PWA storefront for mobile 15-day free trial, setup help included.

records.name: TypeKey
records.tagline: AI writing tools and a keyboard for your iPhone
records.description: Paste your text, tap a tool, copy the result: humanize AI text, paraphrase, fix grammar, summarize, or write a cover letter or an email. No keyboard setup needed. Or turn on the TypeKey keyboard to reply, translate and fix spelling in your other apps.

records.name: We Want To Rent
records.tagline: Your UK rental journey, from shortlist to move-out
records.description: We Want To Rent brings your UK rental search and life at home into one shared workspace. Save property links, compare homes, organise viewings and keep everyone moving with you in sync. When you get the keys, keep tenancy documents, condition photos, meter readings and repairs together, with checklists for moving in and out. Already renting? Add your home directly. Free during beta, with no card required.

records.name: AIBuilder Marketplace MCP
records.tagline: Dated software prices and cost traps for your AI agent
records.description: A free, read-only MCP server for AI agents that research business software. 500+ tools: every price read on the vendor's own page and dated, every cost trap (per-seat, annual commit, renewal jumps, usage meters) with the sentence it is based on, and cost at your team size where price rules exist. Unknowns stay unknown. No account, no API key: add https://api.aibuildermarketplace.com/mcp to Claude, Cursor or VS Code.

records.name: flagged.
records.tagline: Challenge your friends to a multiplayer flag guessing game
records.description: Hey everyone! I built Flagged to make learning geography more fun, especially with friends. The idea is simple: create a game, share the link, and see who knows their flags best. Jump straight in without signing up, or create an account to add friends and invite them directly. This is my first time putting a game into production, so there are probably bugs I haven’t caught yet. Feedback on the gameplay, UI, or anything else would genuinely help. Give it a try, challenge your friends!

records.name: Panini 1.0
records.tagline: Free, deterministic BSA engine for Indian fintech in-browser
records.description: Indian fintechs pay vendors per-report for bank statement analysis. Panini does it free, inside your own process. Upload a passworded PDF or messy CSV → get income, EMI, FOIR, cash-flow trends & fraud signals back as JSON - every claim carrying a rule ID + the evidence rows it came from. No black-box score. Zero runtime deps. Deterministic. Also ships the only public validators for ReBIT AA / ONDC / OCEN payloads & a multi-AA FIU client. Runs server-side or entirely in-browser.

records.name: Ecomerate
records.tagline: Your AI investment analyst, in iMessage.
records.description: Ecomerate is an AI investment analyst that works through iMessage. It researches the stocks you care about and tracks your investment theses. It also monitors filings, insider activity, catalysts, news and supply-chain changes, and messages you when something actually matters. You don't need to open dashboards, check ten different sources or keep asking an AI the same questions. Ecomerate keeps researching in the background and brings the important changes straight to you.

records.name: SmartHisab
records.tagline: Zero-friction expense tracker with satisfying audio feedback
records.description: SmartHisab is a zero-friction, lightweight expense tracker built to help you log daily income and expenses without the clutter of modern budget apps Highlights Zero Login Required: Open the link and start logging instantly. No bank linking, no email signups Satisfying Feedback: Tactile, coin-drop sound effects whenever you log a transaction PWA Ready: Install directly to your phone or desktop home screen with a single tap Privacy First: 100% of your data stays locally inside your browser storage

records.name: StrangerLens
records.tagline: See what first-time visitors misunderstand about your site
records.description: You understand your website. But do your visitors? StrangerLens analyzes your website from a first-time visitor's perspective, evaluating five key signals: First Impression, Audience, Value, Trust, and Action. Discover what visitors might misunderstand, where your messaging falls short, and what you can improve. Start with a free clarity analysis. Unlock deeper insights, prioritized fixes, and copy-ready improvements with a $5 one-time report. Built for founders, developers, and website owners.

records.name: AI Photo Styler
records.tagline: Your photo, three eighties-inspired moods
records.description: Give a photo an eighties-inspired Family, Studio or Street look. Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB, generate, compare with the original and download a JPEG with a small watermark. No account needed. The free beta allows up to three successful generations per network per UTC day, subject to availability and site-wide limits.

records.name: Covaset 100
records.tagline: Natural Micronized Progesterone I.P. 100mg softgel in Drug
records.description: Covaset 100 contains Natural Micronized Progesterone 100 mg, prescribed for specific hormone-related conditions and reproductive health needs under medical supervision. The dosage and duration depend on the patient's condition and doctor's advice. Ojana Pharmaceuticals is a trusted PCD Pharma Franchise Company in India, offering quality pharmaceutical products, reliable supply, competitive pricing, and professional franchise support to business partners across India.

records.name: Aya Scam & Privacy Lookup
records.tagline: Check unfamiliar callers and messages with source context
records.description: Aya Scam & Privacy Lookup is an Android app for researching unfamiliar U.S. callers and suspicious messages. It presents risk signals with source context and account controls. The app download is free; service checks use paid credits. A score is not proof of identity or safety. The service's permitted-use rules and age requirements apply, and installing the app does not grant unlimited checks.

records.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
records.tagline: DeepSeek’s faster, cheaper Flash model, plus a search API

It also adds a Search and Fetch API. Peak price is $0.30 in and $1.20 out per 1M tokens.

records.name: PDFly XO
records.tagline: Meet XO Link, XO QR, XO Bot & More by PDFly XO
records.description: One platform. Multiple tools. Less hassle. PDFly XO helps you share links, create QR codes, use bot-based tools, and manage ZIP files without switching between multiple websites. - XO Link: Create and share links easily. - XO QR: Generate QR codes for quick access and sharing. - XO Bot: Access useful chat bot-based tools. - XO ZIP: Manage ZIP files online. Built for creators, professionals, and businesses who want simple, practical digital tools in one place. Try PDFly XO and tell us

records.description: Generate listing-ready product images for Shopify, Amazon, Etsy, TikTok Shop, and ads from one product photo.

Browse community-voted channels across Tech, Finance, Gaming, Education and more, and find what YouTube's algorithm misses.

records.name: Pomodoro Timer Online
records.tagline: Minimalist online Pomodoro timer with dark mode & shortcuts
records.description: A calm, distraction-free time-boxing web app for developers and students. Features customizable Pomodoro, short break, and long break intervals, a built-in stopwatch, dark mode, session reports, and fast keyboard shortcuts.

records.name: JSON-LD Structured Data Validator API
records.tagline: Validate a page's schema.org JSON-LD, as JSON
records.description: Give it a page URL, or paste JSON-LD or HTML, and get a JSON report on the schema.org structured data: every JSON-LD block is parsed and checked for @context, @type, required and recommended properties of common rich-result types and typical value mistakes. Coded issues with JSON paths, a grade (A+ to F) and a score out of 100. For SEO audits and CI gates.

records.name: DubaiVisa.pk
