records.description: Will your Dubai visa be approved? A free checker for Pakistanis: answer 6 questions to see your chances this month and how to make your file stronger.

records.name: Novacal
records.tagline: Modern scheduling software for your business
records.description: Novacal grew from a free scheduling tool into a platform for teams and organizations. This launch brings a full rebuild and redesign, paid Pro and Teams plans, custom domains, a full API, and an MCP server for AI assistants.

records.name: GameBrain for WordPress
records.tagline: Game review scores, info cards & prices for WordPress
records.description: GameBrain adds four video game blocks to WordPress: a game info card, a review summary with GameBrain, critic and user scores plus what players like and dislike, a row of similar games, and a where-to-buy price list. The data comes from GameBrain's database of 800,000+ games. Blocks render on your server as HTML with schema.org markup, are cached on your site and use your theme's fonts and colors. You connect with one click and no API key. Free.

records.name: Menu.co.ua - QR Menu Platform
records.tagline: Zero-commission QR menu & table ordering SaaS.
records.description: Digitize your restaurant in minutes with Menu.co.ua. We provide a complete contactless dining experience. Customers simply scan a QR code to view menus and place table orders. You manage everything from one clean dashboard. Features include 0% commissions, multi-language support, analytics, and custom subdomains (e.g., yourcafe.menu.co.ua). A hassle-free SaaS designed to speed up service!

records.name: Goal Instruction Writer
records.tagline: Keep long-running Codex work tied to one outcome
records.description: Turn long Codex tasks into durable Goals with observable outcomes, acceptance evidence, checkpoints, drift controls, and clear completion conditions. Preview the loop before execution. Use focused checks during development and broader verification at delivery gates. Free, MIT licensed. Includes an English case study of a multi-day Godot port; the maintainer reports a longest workflow of 60+ hours.

records.name: Misaca
records.tagline: A free, folder-first photo library for Windows
records.description: Misaca keeps photos and videos in their existing folders. Browse, rate, tag and edit locally, with optional on-device face recognition and tag suggestions. Free for Windows 64-bit.

records.name: CENTURION Carbon Window Tint
records.tagline: Easy-shrinking carbon tint with 30–40% IR rejection
records.description: CENTURION Carbon Window Tint Film combines super-easy shrinking with a 2-ply, 1.5 mil construction for straightforward installation. Its charcoal finish delivers a classic tinted look, while 30–40% infrared rejection helps reduce heat. Designed for installers who value workability, it brings carbon tint performance and practical handling together in one film.

records.name: SafeQuest Lab
records.tagline: AI literacy quests for kids
records.description: The Problem: Kids are using AI tools earlier than ever, but safety education hasn't caught up. The Solution: SafeQuest Lab provides browser-based AI literacy micro-courses and interactive scenario quests for children ages 7–14. In a quick 20-minute workshop format, kids learn how to craft safer prompts, identify AI mistakes, and guard their personal data. Safe, interactive, and kid-friendly!

records.name: Marma-Crypto Protocol
records.tagline: Cryptographic geometric watermarking via Sri Yantra & QES
records.description: Open-source dual-layer document sealing protocol. Maps a 512-bit DSTU 4145-2002 / SHA-256 digest into 24-bit micro-coordinate perturbations across 54 triple intersections of the Sri Yantra, paired with PAdES-B-LTA & RFC 3161 TSP archival signatures.

records.name: ScienceInterest
records.tagline: A simple forum for science projects and discussions.
records.description: Hi Product Hunt! I’m the creator of ScienceInterest. I built this platform because I missed having a simple, distraction-free space to talk about science and find people to collaborate on hobby projects with. Right now, the community is basically just me, so the forums are still empty. I am looking for early testers to jump in, start the very first discussions, and test the features like our milestone certificates. I'd love to hear your honest thoughts! Thanks for the support!

records.name: Heddle
records.tagline: Write X threads & LinkedIn posts from what you read
records.description: Heddle is an AI writing studio for X threads and LinkedIn posts. Import articles and notes, see their key ideas with source quotes, then work with an agent to pick an angle, research, outline and draft in your own voice. Free plan available.

records.name: Arabian Business Times
records.tagline: Where GCC Business Leaders Get Recognised.
records.description: Arabian Business Times is a GCC business media platform connecting leaders, founders, entrepreneurs, and companies across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Oman. Through executive interviews, leader profiles, company features, and expert insights, we cover real estate, AI, technology, finance, and healthcare. We help businesses build credibility, strengthen their digital presence, and improve visibility across Google, Bing, and AI-powered search platforms.

records.name: Sessions Pro for Codex
records.tagline: Run multiple ChatGPT & Codex accounts side by side on Mac
records.description: Sessions Pro for Codex runs several ChatGPT and Codex accounts side by side on your Mac. Each account becomes its own app, like "Codex Work" and "Codex Personal", with its own Dock icon, login, Codex threads, projects, pins and Codex CLI. Start from your current ChatGPT so nothing is lost, switch accounts from the menu bar, and every profile stays up to date when ChatGPT updates. Free 1-hour preview, then $24.99 one-time.

records.name: Kiteva
records.tagline: Turn ideas into motion graphics with AI agents
records.description: Kiteva is an AI-powered motion graphics studio that turns ideas into animated videos and interactive websites using Claude and Codex. Unlike traditional AI video generators, it creates animations through code using Remotion, GSAP, SVG, and WebGL. Explore 136 motion graphic styles, generate storyboards, render previews, and refine results automatically. With local narration, music, and automated quality checks, Kiteva makes creative coding accessible without requiring motion design experience.

records.name: WeProfit.com
records.tagline: Server-side ad tracking and net profit for Shopify stores
records.description: WeProfit sends every Shopify purchase to Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest and 6 more ad networks from our servers, so campaigns keep learning when browsers block tracking. Each order is matched to the visit that brought it, with a confidence label, and shows net profit after product cost, shipping, fees, refunds and ad spend. See which campaigns really make money, run several pixels with conditions, and ask ChatGPT or Claude about your numbers. Live demo, no sign-up.

records.name: ironvault
records.tagline: Protect your Mac from Shadow AI apps
records.description: A Touch ID vault for your Mac that keeps AI tools and other apps out of your private files on your mac. Every file in the vault is encrypted on its own. No app can read one, AI assistants included, unless you approve that exact file with Touch ID. Opening one document never opens the rest, the decrypted copy is wiped automatically, and a Dashboard shows every app that asked for or tried to read a vault file. Contribute to human-frequency/ironvault development by creating an account on GitHub.

records.name: Utilix: Windows Utilities
records.tagline: All Essential Tools! One Powerful App!
records.description: Utilix is your all-in-one Windows productivity toolkit! 🚀 Access Clipboard History, Quick Notes, Screenshot Tool, Color Picker, Screen Ruler, QR Generator, and more in one app. Unlock Premium tools like OCR, Image Compressor, File Encrypter, and Password Generator with a one-time lifetime purchase. Designed for privacy, Utilix works locally on your device without sending your personal data to external cloud servers. Less hassle, more productivity!

records.name: Freelancer & Creator Financial Dashboard
records.tagline: Take control of your money in one printable system.
records.description: Take control of your money in one printable system. This 6-page PDF tracks everything a freelancer or creator needs to run their finances like a pro — income by client, business expenses, quarterly tax estimates, annual revenue trends, and your client pipeline from first lead to paid invoice. No software, no subscriptions, no spreadsheet setup. Just print, fill, and finally know where your money is going. Perfect for freelancers, content creators, side hustlers, and solopreneurs.

records.name: PlumPDF
records.tagline: Free PDF and image tools that run in your browser
records.description: Convert images and text to PDF, turn PDF pages into images or text, merge, split, rotate, reorder, compress, sign, OCR or password-protect PDFs, and convert, compress, resize or crop images. Everything runs in your browser.

records.name: LowScout
records.tagline: Find recurring charges and catch the ones that change
records.description: LowScout finds the recurring money hiding in your accounts — forgotten subscriptions, annual renewals, price increases, and charges you don't recognize — then keeps watching. A deterministic engine reads your real transactions and names every recurring charge with its evidence, your exact monthly and yearly totals, and what's coming up. Mark a charge canceled and if it appears again, LowScout surfaces it. Two ways in, neither required: connect a bank read-only, or upload a PDF or CSV statement.

records.name: Toydeji Lab
records.tagline: Y2K toy-camera photo filters—free, private, in your browser.
records.description: ToyDig Lab turns your everyday photos into nostalgic toy-camera shots. Choose from 17 filters inspired by early-2000s CCD digicams, disposable cameras, Lomo and 35mm film, then fine-tune the strength to get the look you want. Add a retro date stamp pulled from your photo’s EXIF data, or finish with film, instant or white-border frames. Everything runs inside your browser, so your images never leave your device. No sign-up, no uploads, completely free. Batch-edit and save as ZIP, even offline.

records.name: Tessera
records.tagline: Six worlds, daily puzzles, and live 1v1 block duels
records.description: Tessera is a free-to-download Android block puzzle wth strategic 8x8 line-clearing, six customizable visal worlds, Daily challenges and Endless mode. Live Del adds 1v1 competitive play: friends alternate time turns on the same board, so every placement can affct their opponent. Joining is free and hosting unlocs for $0.99 once. Includes ads and optional in-app prchases. Developed by Case Sensitive Computers, LLC.

records.name: Daymark: Claim Your Days
records.tagline: Claim your day in history and set how it is celebrated
records.description: Daymark is a social memory app built around a simple idea: every day in history can belong to someone. Pick any date — yesterday, the day you graduated, the day your grandmother was born — and claim it as your own. Add a photo, give it a title, tell the story if you want to. That day is now marked. Choose a day. Any day in history, as far back as you like. Add a memory. One photo, one title, and an optional story. Claim it. The day becomes part of your timeline. Each day can only be claimed...

records.name: Evane
records.tagline: Every Event Cognitively Convened
records.description: Evane is an AI agent designed for government-enterprise collaboration and complex, multi-stakeholder programs, where alignment, accountability and speed determine outcomes. It replaces fragmented communication with a unified data foundation, automates repetitive work, and gives leaders real-time tracking and early bottleneck alerts.

records.name: MiControl – Personal Finance
records.tagline: Take control of your income, expenses and monthly budget
records.description: MiControl is a simple and easy-to-use personal finance app that helps you manage your income, expenses, and monthly budget in one place. No complicated spreadsheets or financial knowledge required. Start with the free version and unlock Premium with a one-time payment of €14.99. No subscriptions. Take control of your money, one expense at a time!

records.name: Sentinela IA
records.tagline: Free scanner for websites, scam links, videos and clones
records.description: Unlike heavy enterprise tools, Sentinela IA requires zero signup and unifies 4 defenses into one clean box: technical website security audits, scam/phishing link inspection, deceptive video analysis, and active brand clone detection. It gives instant free diagnostics with actionable evidence, optional in-depth PDF remediation reports ($4.99), and an embeddable verified trust badge for audited sites.

records.name: Projectabe
records.tagline: Discover independent websites, apps and new projects
records.description: Projectabe helps you discover interesting websites, apps and independent projects. Explore what people are building, share your own project, and help great ideas get discovered.

records.name: Impossible Spaces
records.tagline: Explore 50+ surreal 3D worlds where reality bends
records.description: Step into 50+ interactive 3D worlds where buildings unfold, gravity shifts, and paths loop back on themselves. Impossible Spaces brings surreal architecture to your browser with real-time WebGL, ambient sound, and poetic field notes in English and Chinese. Orbit each scene, change viewpoints, and control the pace of its moving structures. Seven themes invite you to explore time, cause, gravity, perception, scale, form, and paths.

records.name: Finder

records.tagline: Changelog + feature voting widget in one 7.5KB script tag
records.description: FeaturePulse adds a floating bell to your app: a "What's new" changelog with an unread badge and a feature request board where visitors suggest and upvote ideas without an account. Ideas move through Under review, Planned, In progress and Completed, and users see the status right in the widget. One script tag, ~7.5 KB gzipped, Shadow DOM so your site's CSS can't break it. Free public beta: every feature unlocked, no card needed.

records.name: FilaWarden
records.tagline: Security and health monitoring for Laravel Filament panels
records.description: FilaWarden is an operations and security plugin for Laravel Filament 4 and 5. Core is free and MIT: a 5-vector health score, a 12-point deployment auditor, queue and cron monitors, database footprint, error-log tail, and SSL checks. Pro adds leaked-key scanning, APM slow queries, incidents, and webhook alerts. No extra daemon.

records.name: How to Build Credit From Scratch:
records.tagline: How to Build Credit From Scratch: Beginner Guide 2026
records.description: New to credit? Learn safe ways to start, from starter cards to authorized users, and how to build a good score over time.

records.tagline: Digital Restaurant Menus That Wow

records.name: Scrambl: Photo Obfuscation
records.tagline: Password-seeded photo obfuscation on device.

Standard messaging apps expose shared images immediately in the thread. Vault apps often force accounts, cloud uploads, and heavy UI.

Instead of waiting for inbound leads to reach your website, Startories finds the demand already happening across the web.

records.description: Groundbeat is a real-time pulse of the nation. Twice a day an AI editorial desk reads the news and drafts neutral polls on everything from Congress to soulmates. Vote in one tap, no signup, then make your case in the comments. Members are the official count.

records.name: SeeTheScale

records.description: Big numbers are hard to feel. SeeTheScale turns them into graphics you can grasp – stacks of $100 bills, a football field and more. Browse curated comparisons with sources or build your own, by hand or with AI. Free to try, no account needed.

records.description: ORIN is the project token of the Oral Insulin Network: a neutral evidence network for any oral insulin that works. ERC-20 on Base, paired with wNEWS. No needle. No blood. Just protection, release and delivery.

records.name: VIMANA
records.tagline: India's live flight tracker with 3D views and landing alerts
records.description: VIMANA is a live flight tracker built for India. See aircraft over Indian skies on a live map, open any flight for its route, timings and progress, or follow it in a 3D chase view. Search the way India flies, "Delhi to Mumbai" or "6E 2134", and get alerts when a flight departs or lands. Airport guides show lounges and which cards get you in. Free, no login, and honest: estimated positions are clearly marked.

records.name: Pro Sens Converter
records.tagline: 1:1 mouse sensitivity converter & web aim trainer
records.description: Pro Sens Converter is an ad-free, open-source web application designed for competitive shooter players to seamlessly match their mouse sensitivity across different game engines.Convert your mouse sensitivity across competitive games, find your cm/360, and test your reaction time.

records.name: Chrome Appearance Switcher

Chrome Appearance Switcher bridges this gap by pairing a modern MV3 extension with a lightweight local native messaging companion on Windows. With a single click or global hotkey (Alt + Shift + D), Chrome repaints its actual UI between Light and Dark mode in real time without restarting the browser.

records.name: SubmitKit
records.tagline: A filterable sheet of 308 places to submit your product

records.description: Learn how credit scores work and 10 practical steps to raise yours, with a 90-day plan. Plus enter to win a $150 or $100 gift card.

records.name: SpiritFone
records.tagline: SpiritFone is here!
records.description: SpiritFone is an ITC (Instrumental Trans Communication) tool for paranormal research. It allows investigators to listen to spirit voices live in real time. White noise is processed through a chain of filters that ultimately reveals live, real time EVP (Electronic Voice Phenomena).

records.name: qClock
records.tagline: A nice clock with built-in calendar, holiday markers
records.description: Meet qClock—a playful, customizable desktop clock that makes tracking time effortless and fun. Featuring an interactive calendar that highlights holidays set in your settings, qClock shows you details at a glance with a quick hover. Easily switch time zones, customize your time display, explore historical events, and resize the clock on the fly with a scroll of your mouse wheel.

records.name: Flich | motion graphics with AI
records.tagline: Motion graphics advertisements with AI model of your choice.
records.description: Running a business or a SaaS? You need motion graphics: launch videos, explainers, ads. Agencies charge $1,000+ and take weeks. Flich makes them in minutes, for under $1. Just describe your video, pick your AI model, and get a polished 1080p video with animation and sound, ready to post. Want a change? Just ask. We built Flich because great marketing videos shouldn’t be a luxury. Now they’re for everyone ♥ Your first video is free.

records.name: yourreferralcodes.com
records.tagline: Find and share referral codes, compare which is the best.
records.description: A directory of referral codes where you can share and find referral codes and links. Also, you can compare the different referral codes to see which one is better (reward for effort). Browse banks, brokers, shops and apps, or submit your own code. Available in English and Spanish.

records.name: MoreRoom
records.tagline: See what fills your Mac and free up space without fear
records.description: MoreRoom scans your Mac in seconds, shows every file on one clear map and explains what each thing is. Items are labelled "Safe to remove" or "Review first", everything goes to the Trash first and can be undone. No scare tactics, no fake junk counters.

records.name: meowblast - cat puzzle block
records.tagline: Place tiles, blast lines, and rescue adorable cats!
records.description: Meow Blast is a cat block puzzle game where you fit blocks onto an 8×8 grid, clear full rows and columns, and rescue cats as you go. If you like classic block puzzles, you already know how to play. Drag a piece onto the board, fill a line, and watch it clear. Simple to start, but the board fills up quicker than you’d think. Drag blocks onto the 8×8 board Complete a full row or column to clear it and earn points Clear lines to rescue cats and unlock new cat characters Blocks can’t be moved...

records.name: Markeoa
records.tagline: Discover what your business should market next
records.description: Markeoa helps businesses discover what to market next. Research your business, explore competitors and market signals, identify marketing opportunities, and turn insights into actionable content with AI. Built for founders, freelancers, marketers, and small businesses who want to make more informed marketing decisions. Try Markeoa: https://markeoa.com

records.name: Jummah Mubarak
records.tagline: Beautiful Friday wishes, duas, quotes & images to share.
records.description: Jummah Mubarak is a free collection of beautiful Friday wishes, duas, quotes and images in English and Urdu. Copy, download and share heartfelt Jummah greetings with family and friends — no signup needed. New wishes are added regularly, so every Friday can start with barakah. Whether you want a short dua for a WhatsApp status or a beautiful image to send to loved ones, it is all here in one peaceful place.

records.name: Akon Mobile
records.tagline: Akon Mobile Classified Marketplace in Bangladesh
records.description: Akon Mobile is a tech related news website and a marketplace for our Bangladesh. Buy and sell all kinds of new or used products, list your business, and post jobs and services easily from your mobile. Find phones, laptops, electronics, fashion, furniture, vehicles, property and more in one place. Post job vacancies to hire skilled people, and offer services to win new customers. Post a free ad with photos and price in minutes and connect directly with local buyers and customers.

records.name: Chauffleet
records.tagline: Bookings, dispatch & your own app for chauffeur fleets
records.description: Chauffleet helps chauffeur and taxi operators manage bookings, drivers, vehicles, live GPS tracking, payments and invoicing in one place. Give customers a booking experience under your own brand, with a customizable booking form and a mobile app that adapts to drivers or passengers. Pro Fleeter adds automated dispatch, a branded website and a partner API. Built for operators who want to manage their business and grow direct bookings.

records.name: Syllaby Mobile App
records.tagline: Save Up to 70% Of Your Content-Creation Time on the Go
records.description: Syllaby is your all-in-one AI studio for viral video creation. Instantly turn ideas into faceless or cinematic content with trending topics, ready-to-film scripts, and studio-quality visuals. From planning to publishing, Syllaby streamlines every step—so your content stays consistent, professional, and unmistakably yours.

records.name: Clubs, Events and Esports
records.tagline: Play. Host. Belong - One Home
records.description: Eventa is one app for live events. Discover concerts, meetups, esports tournaments and clubs near you, or host your own. Sell e-tickets or take RSVPs, book venues by quote, check guests in with QR codes, and promote with SMS and email campaigns. Run clubs with paid tiers and Clubs Compete tournaments, and earn reward points. Live in South Asia, USA and Canada, on web, iOS and Android

records.name: Ellie — Elephant in the Room
records.tagline: A deaf baby elephant who fingerspells any word in ASL
records.description: Ellie is a deaf baby elephant who signs with her trunk. Give her any word and she'll fingerspell it for you — one letter at a time, with big, friendly captions. Choose your manual alphabet: ASL, Libras, or BSL (her sister Tunk helps with BSL's two hands). Ellie is a free widget that lives at ellie.mrbray.com and embeds on any website with one line of code. No audio, no account — just a joyful deaf character putting herself at the heart of the story.

records.name: Startup Malpractice Quiz
records.tagline: Find out what's professionally wrong with you.
records.description: The startup world is full of visionaries, thought leaders, growth hackers, and people who haven't made a sale but somehow have a podcast. Startup Malpractice brings that same energy to a quiz. Find out which corporate or startup stereotype you are, and discover whether you're the problem everyone complains about in Slack. It's satire, not a personality assessment. Please don't put your result on LinkedIn. Unless you're a thought leader. Then you absolutely will.

records.name: DriveIQ.es
records.tagline: Duolingo meets TikTok for Spain's driving theory exam
records.description: Preparing for Spain's DGT driving exam shouldn't mean studying on 20-year-old ad-cluttered portals. DriveIQ brings driver ed into 2026 with a mobile-first, TikTok-style swipe interface, 1,800+ DGT-style questions, and instant Gemini AI explanations tailored to your exact mistake. Features include SM-2 spaced repetition, a 0–100 exam readiness score, an 18-topic audio handbook and a full English mode, so you know when you're ready without stepping into an academy.

records.name: Trendai.video
records.tagline: Turn one photo into this week's viral AI video trends
records.description: Hey Product Hunt 👋 Every week a new AI video trend takes over TikTok and Reels, and recreating it usually means juggling prompts, models and editing apps. We built Trendai.video so it takes one photo: pick the trend, upload, done. We add new trends every day, so tell us in the comments which trend we should add next and we'll try to ship it during launch week 🙏

records.name: Perplexity Decisions API
records.tagline: Get structured decisions from text, JSON, and images
records.description: Perplexity Decisions is an API for getting structured judgments from text, JSON, and images. Ask yes/no, choice, or scoring questions and get probabilities instead of prose. It supports 1-128 questions per request, PNG, JPEG, and WebP images, and the pplx-decider-v1-27b model. Pricing is $0.04 per million input tokens, with free output tokens. The API supports up to 10 requests/sec per organization. Try it with any Perplexity API key.

records.name: Zui
records.tagline: Study out loud: an AI that quizzes you before your exams
records.description: Re-reading notes feels productive but barely works. Being quizzed does. Tell Zui what your exam covers, tap the mic, and it asks you out loud, listens, tells you what you missed and keeps going, hands-free. • Experts: quiz me, explain it, essay feedback, oral exam rehearsal, English practice • Subjects from the Spanish high-school syllabus • Remembers what you struggled with last time Spanish only for now. iOS & Android, and you can start without paying.

records.name: SeoJae Story
records.tagline: Classic books in easy English, with Korean under every line
records.description: SeoJae Story turns famous books into short, graded readings (CEFR A1–B2) so English learners actually finish them. Every sentence has a natural Korean translation written by people, not machines. Tap any word for its meaning and real example sentences, listen to neural narration at 0.5×–1.5×, save words as flashcards, and open the author's original text when you're ready. Novels, philosophy, money classics, biographies and Korean literature. No account needed.

records.name: NIALUS
records.tagline: Your AI executive producer for podcasts and YouTube
records.description: Plan, build and repurpose your show with an AI Executive Producer that NIALUS is your AI executive producer for podcasts and YouTube. Get up to 15 show-specific topic ideas, then turn one into an episode outline, script, titles, descriptions and social content. Producer Memory keep your voice, audience and creative direction in context, while your Episode Library keeps your work organized. Go from “What should I talk about?” to a clear plan without writing a separate prompt for every piece.

records.name: SlideCraft
records.tagline: Editable PowerPoint decks from one prompt
records.description: Paste one prompt into ChatGPT, Claude or Codex and get an editable PowerPoint, not a picture of slides. 20 years of board decks, written down as rules any AI follows: action titles, 46 measured layouts, a source for every number, a review of every slide.

records.name: NextShow.live - live music with friends
records.tagline: Find the live music you love, and the friends to go with
records.description: I built this for my group of friends that goes to concerts together. Maybe your friend group will like it too.

records.name: Flower Atelier & Co.
records.tagline: Warm Fall Wishes Bouquet
records.description: $ 79.95 Size: SEveryone falls for this fabulous fall gift! Celebrate the season with this autumn arrangement of roses and alstroemeria, arranged in a classic ceramic pumpkin they’ll use year after year! Includes a lush mix of orange roses, orange alstroemeria, burgundy cushion chrysanthemums, yellow daisy chrysanthemums, solidago, huckleberry and oak leaves. Delivered in an exclusive ceramic pumpkin with lid.tandard

records.name: Holdy
records.tagline: AI agent that turns more trials into paying customers
records.description: Holdy analyzes how accounts use your SaaS, finds where activation and trial conversion stall, and delivers a GitHub PR or in-app tip ready for your approval. It then measures each change against a control group to show its impact on behavior and revenue.

records.name: AutoAlert: UPI Sound Alert
records.tagline: Hear every UPI payment out loud in English, Hindi or Telugu
records.description: AutoAlert turns any Android phone into a UPI sound box. It reads payment notifications from PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, BHIM and more, and announces each credit aloud in English, Hindi or Telugu. Choose which apps trigger alerts; everything else stays silent. It runs fully on-device with no servers, so payment data never leaves the phone. Optional daily backup goes to your own Google Drive. Built for shopkeepers, vendors and freelancers who can't keep checking the screen.

records.name: XBOX Nano Controller
records.tagline: Pocket-sized wireless gamepad with all 18 inputs
records.description: Take play to more places with the XBOX Nano Controller. Fit more play in your everyday in a smaller form factor. Connect via Bluetooth & play across devices.

records.name: DUE
records.tagline: Brand collaboration workflow, from brief to paid.
records.description: DUE is a web app for independent creators and UGC creators managing brand collaborations. It keeps each collaboration connected from brief through deliverables, approval, invoice and payment follow-up. Creators review extracted brief details and commercial terms, track milestones, build invoices, review suggested bank payment matches and prepare editable overdue follow-up drafts. Optional Scout researches suitable public creator opportunities. Free during early access, with no automatic charges.

records.name: Swiss Weather Bar
records.tagline: Swiss weather and MeteoSwiss warnings in your Mac menu bar
records.description: A free, open-source macOS menu bar app. It shows the forecast for any Swiss postcode and MeteoSwiss weather warnings. No account, no tracking. Available in English, German, French and Italian. Requires macOS 13 or later. The app isn't notarised by Apple, so macOS asks you to approve it on first launch.

records.name: GV VPN
records.tagline: Stay Curious. Stay Connected.
records.description: GV VPN (Global Villager VPN) brings connection choices and device management into one account. Choose a route in the app and find official downloads, setup guidance and support on our website. Available platforms, routes and features depend on the app version and account.

records.name: ELUAI
records.tagline: AI images, videos & visual workflows on one canvas
records.description: ELUAI brings AI image generation, reference-image editing, video creation, and visual workflows into one browser workspace. Turn product photos and prompts into campaign concepts, social content, and storyboards. Explore models, compare variations on an infinite canvas, and keep reusable assets together. Built for ecommerce sellers, designers, and creators, with credit estimates before generation and one-time credit purchases.

records.name: BrandWater AI
records.tagline: Your brand's visibility across every AI answer
records.description: Track how Gemini, Google AI Overview, Google AI Mode, ChatGPT and Perplexity describe your brand, see which competitors and sources they rely on, and get evidence-backed steps to improve. BrandWater AI runs real, repeated audits, not a single screenshot, stores every answer as evidence, and never edits your site on its own: every fix is a reviewed recommendation you approve. Built for marketing and SEO teams who need to prove what AI says about them, not guess.

records.name: INFRO
records.tagline: One control plane for the AI providers you already pay
records.description: INFRO is the control plane for the AI providers you already pay. Connect your own OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Azure, Vertex and more, then call one OpenAI-compatible endpoint: requests fail over across your keys and clouds, budgets refuse spend before the provider call, and every request shows its estimated cost at your rates. Claude Code and Codex route through it too, and INFRO Studio makes images, video and sound on the same accounts. Providers bill you directly; 0% markup on model spend.

records.name: Crazy Frog AI Trend Video Generator
records.tagline: Turn your photos into hilarious Crazy Frog AI chase videos
records.description: Jump into the viral Crazy Frog AI trend! Turn photos of yourself, friends, or favorite characters into hilarious 15-second AI chase videos. Upload a photo of the chased character, customize the motorcycle rider, and choose from 6 backgrounds or upload your own. Powered by Wan 3.0, our generator supports 480P, 720P, and 1080P videos in vertical or horizontal formats. No video editing skills needed. Generate, download, and share your creation on TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts!

records.name: GiNi WMS
records.tagline: AI-powered warehouse management with real-time traceability
records.description: GiNi WMS helps teams manage inventory and warehouse operations, from receiving and replenishment to picking, packing, and dispatch. AI-driven transaction validation and anomaly detection support inventory accuracy, while real-time traceability tracks movements across items, locations, and orders. With voice- and touch-based workflows and integrations with ERP and warehouse control systems, GiNi WMS gives teams greater visibility and control over warehouse execution.

records.name: FancyModels - #1 OF Acquisition Platform
records.tagline: Vetted creator introductions for management agencies.
records.description: FancyModels is an invite-only B2B platform that introduces OnlyFans and creator management agencies to vetted adult creators seeking professional management. Approved agencies filter creator profiles by platform, country, niche and earnings, with a 10-day warranty on every introduction. Features include wishlists, scheduled releases and a moderated red-flag database. Creators join free and confirm they are 18+ and participating voluntarily. Used by 700+ agencies since 2023.

records.name: SnapFrame Studio
records.tagline: Royal 360° 3D mockup, Music Visualizer & Video Studio
records.description: Turn any screenshot, live URL, music track, or code snippet into royal 360° 3D device mockups. Export studio-grade 4K PNGs & animated 360° video loops in seconds. Why it stands out: • 100% Client-Side Privacy (Zero server cost, zero cloud tracking, EXIF scrubbed) • Full 360° Orbit & Turntable Video Recorder • 3D Vinyl Player with live audio waveform spectrum • macOS Glass, iPhone 16 Pro, Arc & Code syntax • Day & Night modes 100% free forever with zero watermarks.

records.name: SEO for SaaS
records.tagline: Cited articles for SaaS blogs. Rewritten when they slip.
records.description: We research, write, and publish cited articles your buyers search for on Google, straight to your own blog through a read-only API and a signed webhook. Every claim links to its source, and every article is fact-checked and edited. When Google Search Console shows an article losing clicks, we rewrite it on the same URL. Publish automatically or review every draft first. For SaaS and app founders, from $49 a month.

records.name: CertSend
records.tagline: Beautiful certificates in seconds. Free, no sign-up.
records.description: CertSend makes beautiful certificates right in your browser: free, no sign-up, no watermark. Pick from 30+ templates (including Hindi and Bengali), or open the Design Studio to build your own from gradients, waves, shapes and your logo, or tap Surprise me for an instant AI-style design. Paste hundreds of names from Excel and get every certificate as PDF, PNG, JPG or SVG. What you see is exactly what you download, and nothing is uploaded: names never leave your device.

records.name: Creatorical
records.tagline: Create long-form videos. From idea to the final cut.
records.description: Create long-form YouTube videos with AI. Write scripts, generate voiceovers, compose videos, and design thumbnails in one workspace. Automate your workflow or stay hands-on with Creatorical.

records.name: Beacon Scout
records.tagline: Bluetooth & BLE Scanner/ Tracker
records.description: A simple app to scan for and track Bluetooth and BLE devices based on their signal strength. It uses the motion sensor of the device for the visual feedback. So you see signal strength vs motion trail. Also allows viewing some of the device details, set favorite devices (has to guess modern devices that rotate their id) and auto reconnect function.

records.name: PalabraFlow
records.tagline: Learn the Mexican Spanish people actually speak
records.description: PalabraFlow teaches the Mexican Spanish people actually speak: 1,000 real phrases in 40 everyday situations, from taco stands and Ubers to markets, the pharmacy and small talk with neighbors. Hear every phrase in a Mexican voice, say it out loud and see exactly which words to fix. Fluency adds an AI tutor that talks back like a local and scores every sentence. Built for travelers, expats, and anyone with Mexican family or friends. Free to start on iPhone and Android.

records.name: Image to Layers
records.tagline: Turn flat images into editable layers for PSD or ZIP
records.description: Split PNG, JPEG and WebP images into editable layers with AI. Review the results, download a ZIP, or assemble a PSD in your browser. Eligible new accounts get one Low + Automatic trial; then pay with credits. Sign-in required. Results vary; complete separation is not guaranteed.

records.name: PasteKit
records.tagline: Format JSON, YAML & SQL privately
records.description: Paste JSON, YAML, XML, SQL, CSV or code and get formatted, validated output instantly. 58 formats, 48 converters and JSON tools (diff, schema, repair, jq). Everything runs in your browser, enforced by a strict CSP, so nothing you paste leaves your machine.

records.name: Charter
records.tagline: Open-source Composio alternative for AI agents
records.description: A Python library that turns any API into an agent tool you own. No third-party server, no per-call pricing, no rate limits on top. Your rules decide what the agent sees and sends, and a call that breaks one never reaches the API.

records.name: Setup Essentials
records.tagline: 🎤 “Be Heard. Sound Better.”
records.description: 1. 9 ms ultra-low latency,20 m barrier-free reception, it can use outdoor live broadcasts and take a small video.2. It doesn't need an APP, plug-and-play, or one-click connection, easy to wear.3. Intelligent noise reduction, long endurance of 10 hours, easy to cope with all kinds of noisy environments,worry-free shooti

records.name: GiNi WES
records.tagline: AI-driven warehouse execution and task optimization
records.description: GiNi WES turns warehouse orders into structured tasks and coordinates execution across warehouse operations. Its AI-driven approach helps optimize workflows, prioritize tasks, and provide real-time visibility into execution. Designed to work across warehouse processes, GiNi WES helps teams coordinate activities and respond to changing operational demands with greater efficiency.

records.name: Squash the Squab
records.tagline: Settle petty fights with a grumpy courtroom judge
records.description: Two people, one petty argument, one judge. You file your side, it stays sealed, and the other person gets a summons link to tell theirs from their own phone. No app, no account. Once both sides are in, Judge Whiskerton names the guilty party, invents a mock-legal charge, and hands down a silly sentence, plus a courtroom video of the ruling you can post. Arguing alone? Put a hot take on trial against The Internet. Free.

records.name: QuizChamp
records.tagline: Daily trivia adventures, mini-games & quests in your browser
records.description: Hey Community! 👋 I’m thrilled (and a bit nervous!) to launch QuizChamp today! 🏆Are you looking for a great, varied new quiz app? If so, I’d love to invite you to check out my own app. I’ve poured a lot of heart and soul into it, and I’d be delighted if you gave it a try. You can look forward to a huge pool of questions, regular updates, and seasonal events (currently Halloween). here is the app link as well: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.base69ebac44fe204e430be7fd31.app

records.name: Master Kael
records.tagline: One LeetCode problem. One question at a time.
records.description: master kael is a tutor for making you understand leetcode questions by having an insightful conversation with the users. It asks one question at a time and keeps the statement plus about what you already know, until you reach the answer. Use it online, or run it on your own machine.

records.name: FinTrack — AI Expense Tracker
records.tagline: Track expenses and income without leaving Telegram
records.description: FinTrack is a Telegram bot that shows where your money goes. Type "coffee 5" or send a voice message, and AI suggests the category. No app to install, no forms. • Monthly reports and charts in a built-in Mini App • Expenses and income in one place, any currency • All records are kept in Google Sheets • Daily reminders to keep the habit • Import your history from another app via CSV Works in English, Ukrainian and Russian. Landing page - https://fintrackbot.investflows.com/

records.name: RewriteAI
records.tagline: Turn robotic AI text into natural, human-sounding writing
records.description: RewriteAI is an all-in-one workspace to humanize and analyze AI text. Unlike tools that just swap synonyms, our smart paraphrasing engine restructures sentences, clauses, and rhythm to mirror natural human variation while strictly preserving your original facts and meaning. Pair text humanization across 5 distinct writing styles (Academic, Professional, etc.) with an intelligent probabilistic detector. Built for creators, SEOs, and teams to streamline content workflows.

records.name: FreeVideoGenerator
records.tagline: Free AI video generator — text & photos to video
records.description: Free AI video generator: turn text prompts and photos into video clips with Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Wan and more. Free starter credits, no sign-up friction, no watermark downloads.

records.name: VYRE OS & Apps
records.tagline: Local AI on your hardware. One connected ecosystem.
records.description: Sovereign AI on your infrastructure, connected by design. Run supported AI workloads with VYRE OS on dedicated Linux machines or VYRE Edge App on existing Windows devices. Manage device enrollment, configuration and coordination through VYRE Cloud, and access connected business information with IVY by VYRE on mobile. One ecosystem for local execution, central coordination and mobile access.

records.name: WordStory
records.tagline: Learn German words with funny sound-alike pictures
records.description: Every German word gets a funny picture and a short sound-alike story: "kommen" sounds like "come, men!". Nouns come with der/die/das in color, and practice brings words back before you forget. 1,000+ words, A1–B1. Tap any word to hear it, keep every word in your own library, share a word as a picture card, and see a German word on your Home Screen widget. Free: 10 new words a day plus practice, no account, works offline. Pro opens every word, monthly, yearly or once for life.

records.name: QRBlitz: QR & Barcode Scanner
records.tagline: Scan any QR code or barcode instantly, 100% private
records.description: QRBlitz is a fast, free QR code scanner and barcode reader for Android. Point your camera and it scans instantly, no buttons to press. Scan codes from your photo gallery, generate custom QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, contacts and more, and use the flashlight in dark environments. Everything stays 100% private on your device, no accounts, no tracking. Built for speed and simplicity.

records.name: Audio Selector
records.tagline: Switch audio devices and sample rates from your Mac menu bar
records.description: Audio Selector puts every audio device on your Mac one click away in the menu bar - outputs and inputs alike - and shows the current device and format right there. It also changes bit depth and sample rate (up to 32-bit/768kHz) without opening Audio MIDI Setup, and a free iPhone app turns your phone into a remote for device, volume and format. Software volume for DACs with no volume control. Free to use; Pro is a one-time upgrade with no subscription.

records.name: AEO & WCAG Scanner by AEO Ready
records.tagline: Free AI search (GEO) readiness & ADA compliance checker
records.description: Instantly audit any domain to see if multi-modal LLMs (ChatGPT, Perplexity) cite your brand or if your DOM has critical WCAG 2.2 accessibility barriers. Get schema diagnostics and shareable scorecards in seconds with zero sign-up required.

records.name: FearGreedFlow
records.tagline: Market sentiment, stock research and charts in one place
records.description: Track the Fear & Greed Index, compare sentiment with stocks and ETFs, explore market maps, save watchlists, and research ideas with charts and backtesting. Includes a free tier and API access.

records.name: Fundstash
records.tagline: Private expense tracker that reads your bank SMS
records.description: Fundstash turns the bank, card and UPI SMS you already get into a clean expense tracker, automatically. What makes it different: everything happens on your phone. No account, no bank login, no cloud. Your data is encrypted on the device and never leaves it. • Auto-tracks spends from bank SMS (Shortcuts on iPhone) • Smart categories, budgets, bills, goals • Split bills and IOUs with one link • Receipt scanning • Optional on-device AI: ask "How much on food this month?" Free. No ads.

records.name: 3DRoll
records.tagline: 3D dice for game night, date night and "what's for dinner?"
records.description: Free 3D dice roller with real physics. Runs in any browser, no signup. Classic D4–D100 for D&D and board games, plus themed dice: date night, truth or dare, what to eat, yes/no, chores, workouts. Custom dice, shareable results, 11 languages.

records.name: Tachiko Work
records.tagline: Semantic spreadsheets where AI proposes, Rust verifies.
records.description: Tachiko Work is a semantic workspace for structured data where humans and AI operate on typed meaning instead of raw cells. For the GPT-6 Astra Challenge, Astra turns natural-language intent into typed proposals; Tachiko’s deterministic Rust engine validates formulas, dependencies, and impact before anything changes. Tachiko Sheet provides the familiar spreadsheet experience on top. Public pre-alpha.

records.name: Reamp
records.tagline: Hi-res music player for Mac with Winamp skins
records.description: Reamp 2.0 is a major rebuild of the native macOS player. Winamp Classic and Modern skins, hi-res playback at the file's native sample rate, DSD over DoP, crossfade, multiple EQ types, a new media library, audiobooks, podcasts, online radio, video, AVS visualizations and device sync. Universal build for Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 10.14+.

records.name: SmartDuck
records.tagline: Lower the volume of YouTube ads, automatically
records.description: YouTube ads usually come in louder than whatever you were watching, even with Stable Volume on. SmartDuck turns the volume down when an ad starts and brings it back when it ends. It doesn't block ads, they still play, just quieter. Everything runs in your browser.

records.name: Change Radar
records.tagline: Analyze project changes and surface check results in VS Code
records.description: Change Radar is a VS Code extension built to help developers analyze project changes and understand check results without leaving their editor. I’ve just released version 0.0.2 and am looking for early users to test it in real development workflows. This launch is about getting honest feedback from developers, discovering what’s most useful, and identifying what needs improvement. If you work with VS Code projects, give Change Radar a try and help shape its future.
